blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Given a single text and a simple zero-shot prompt (no web access, tools, candidate lists, or writing samples), frontier models can answer "who wrote this?" at three increasingly specific levels: (1) whether an AI or human wrote it, (2) if an AI, which lab, and (3) if a human, often exactly who. The latest models (Claude Fable 5.2, GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 4 Carbon) match trained detectors like Pangram while also explaining their predictions in natural language, and Opus 5.5 names the correct lab for 98% of texts generated by models from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. Most strikingly, Fable 5.2 correctly names the author of 39% of public peer reviews published in Oct-Nov 2026 (78% on a subset of reviews from Nature), and identifies the username behind 69% of comments from active Redditors (with >500 posts over the last year). Accuracy depends on exposure to an author's writing in pretraining data and on reasoning effort, and simply asking a model how familiar it is with someone predicts whether it can identify their writing. For anyone who has published enough writing online, frontier models present a greater threat to anonymity than commonly assumed, and defenses are limited.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个单一的文本和一个简单的零镜头即时(没有网络访问,工具,候选名单,或写样本),前沿模型可以在三个越来越具体的层面上回答"是谁写的?":(1)是AI还是人类写的,(2)是AI,哪个实验室写的,(3)是人类写的,往往是确切的谁写的. 最新的模型(Claude Fable 5.2,GPT-6.1 Sol,双子座4 Carbon)匹配了Pangram等受过训练的探测器,同时也用自然语言解释它们的预测,Opus 5.5将来自Anthropic,OpenAI,Google的模型生成的98%的文本命名为正确的实验室. 最令人惊讶的是,Fable 5.2在2026年十月-十一月发布的公开同行评审中,39%的作者正确命名(78%来自自然评论的子集),并且确定69%来自活跃的Redditors的评论背后的用户名(去年有 > 500个帖子). 准确性取决于作者在预训数据中的写作和推理努力的暴露,只是问一个模型对某人的熟悉程度如何预测它是否能够识别他们的写作. 对任何在网上发表足够著作的人来说,前沿模型对匿名性的威胁比通常假设的要大,辩护也很有限.

blocks.en:
In May 2026, the eventual winner of the Commonwealth Short Story Prize was accused of using AI to write their story. Granta, the literary magazine that published the story, was widely mocked for the naivety of its investigation: it simply asked Claude whether AI had written the story. 1 1 1 For the reaction, see this post on X .
The author was cleared of misconduct, and the story went on to win the overall prize. In this paper, we show that Granta was not naive, but just a few months early. Frontier models now identify AI text as well as specialized detectors like Pangram, and they go much further: given a single text, with no web search or list of candidates, they can often name the lab behind an AI-generated text, or even the specific person who wrote a human one ( Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh:
2026年5月,最终的英联邦短篇故事奖得主被指责利用AI撰写他们的故事. 出版该故事的文学杂志格兰塔因其调查的天真而被广泛嘲讽:它只是问克劳德是否是AI写的故事. 1,1 反应,请参见X上的此帖.
作者被洗清行为失检,故事继续获得总奖. 在这份论文中,我们显示格兰塔并非天真,而是提前几个月. 边疆模型现在识别AI文本以及Pangram等专业探测器,它们走得更远:给出一个单一文本,没有网络搜索或候选名单,它们往往可以在AI生成的文本后面给实验室命名,甚至给写人类文本的具体人物命名(图1).

blocks.en: Human or AI? Frontier models can detect AI prose and ideas: Using a simple zero-shot prompt, we show that frontier models are competitive with state-of-the-art detectors of AI text (Pangram 4.1; Glickenhaus et al., 2026 ) and AI ideas (IdeaLens; Rajendhran et al., 2026 ). On 36K documents from 24 benchmark datasets, Gemini 4 Carbon detects 97% of fully AI-generated texts vs. 97% for Pangram 4.1, at the same false positive rate (0.01% of English human texts), while GPT-6.1 Sol reaches 90% accuracy on idea detection compared to 87% for IdeaLens. Unlike most detectors, frontier models can also explain their predictions in natural language, and we find that these explanations agree with features of AI text and ideas discovered by prior work.
blocks.zh: 人类还是人工智能? 前沿模型可以检测AI的传言和想法: 使用简单的零射速率,我们显示前沿模型与AI文本(Pangram 4.1;Glickenhaus等人,2026年)和AI思想(IdeaLens;Rajendhran等人,2026年)的先进探测器具有竞争力. 在来自24个基准数据集的36K文件中,双子座4 Carbon检测到97%的完全AI生成的文本对Pagram 4.1的97%,以相同的假正率(英语人文文本的0.01%),而GPT-6.1 Sol在想法检测上达到90%的精度,而IdeaLens的精度为87%. 与大多数探测器不同,边疆模型也可以用自然语言来解释其预测,我们发现这些解释与AI文本的特征和先前作品发现的想法是一致的.

blocks.en:
If AI, which AI? Frontier models can name the lab behind an AI-generated text: We create a dataset of short stories, news articles, and op-eds generated by 34 models from 11 labs, and prompt frontier models (with a minimally modified version of the same zero-shot prompt) to name the lab and model behind each text. Despite recent studies reporting increasing homogeneity in AI writing ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Russell et al., 2026b ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Gill et al., 2026 ) , Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon both name the correct lab for 98% of texts generated by Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. They are much less accurate on texts produced by the other eight labs (at most 35%), perhaps due to distillation ( Anthropic, 2026b ; Seetharaman & Arámburo, 2026 ) : Moonshot’s Kimi K3 is usually mistaken for Claude, and Alibaba’s Qwen3.8 models for GPT.
The explanations reveal how frontier models view each lab’s style (e.g., associating Gemini with clichés and invented quotes).
blocks.zh:
如果是AI,哪个AI? 边疆模型可以在AI生成的文本后面命名实验室: 我们创建了一个由来自11个实验室的34个模型生成的短篇故事,新闻文章,以及专栏版的数据集,并促使前沿模型(最小修改的版本是相同的零镜头提示)为每个文本背后的实验室和模型命名. 尽管最近有研究表明AI写作中的同质性在不断增强(Jiang等人,2026年;Russell等人,2026年b;Kim等人,2026年;Gill等人,2026年),Opus 5.5和双子座4 Argon都为Anthropic,OpenAI和Google生成的98%的文本命名了正确的实验室. 其他8个实验室生产的文本(最多35%)的准确性要低得多(Anthropic, 2026b; Seitharaman & Aránburo, 2026) : Moonshot的Kimi K3通常被误认为克劳德,阿里巴巴的Qwen3.8型GPT.
这些解释揭示了前沿模型如何看待每个实验室的风格(例如,将双子座与陈词滥调联系起来并发明引文).

blocks.en: If human, which human? Frontier models can name the person who wrote a text: Identifying the author of a human-written text is a far more open-ended task than detecting which lab wrote an AI text. Nevertheless, given just a text and the same prompt, Claude Fable 5.2 names the reviewer of 56% of 398 private peer reviews whose authorship was never made public. 2 2 2 We will include results from a substantially larger study that covers thousands of anonymous peer reviews in an upcoming update to this paper. On texts published after its training cutoff, it also names the reviewer of 78% of Nature -family reviews, the writer of all 15 stories by authors with > > 1M Goodreads ratings, at least one author of 46% of arXiv papers, and the username behind 69% of comments made by active Redditors. A model’s stated confidence is informative too: when Fable 5.2 reports 25% or higher confidence, it predicts the right author 87% of the time. Unlike recent work on deanonymization with LLMs ( Lermen et al., 2026 ) , none of these results required a pool of candidates, web access, or writing samples—the model relies solely on its parametric knowledge.
blocks.zh: 如果说是人类,哪个人类? 边疆模型可以给写一个文本的人起名: 识别一个人类写作文本的作者是一项远比检测哪个实验室写AI文本更开放的任务. 然而,只要一个文本和同样迅速,Claude Fable 5.2就指定了398个私人同行评审中56%的评审者,其作者身份从未公开. 2个 2 我们将在即将对本文件进行的更新中,列入一项涉及数千份匿名同行审评的更大规模研究的结果。 在培训结束后出版的文本中,它也指定了78%的《自然-家庭评论》的评论者,作者所有15个故事的编剧。 1M Goodreads收视率,至少一位作者占arXiv论文的46%,用户名落后于活跃的Redditors69%的评论. 一个模型所宣称的自信也提供了信息:当Fable 5.2报告25%或更高的信心时,它预测右作者在87%的时间里会有所作为。 与最近与LLMs(Lermen等人,2026年)进行的去名化工作不同,这些结果都不需要一个候选人库、网络访问或书写样本——模型完全依赖其参数化知识。

blocks.en:
Accuracy depends on how much of a writer’s text a model has likely seen during pretraining ( Razeghi et al., 2022 ; Kandpal et al., 2023 ) . For example, Opus 5.5 identifies only 20% of stories by authors it rates moderately familiar, none of the 91 stories by unknown authors, and none of the Reddit accounts without prior activity in the subreddit. Pretraining corpora for frontier models are inaccessible, so corpus lookups like Infini-gram ( Liu et al., 2024 ) cannot be run on them. However, simply asking a frontier model how well it knows someone (given only their name or username) predicts its accuracy in advance.
Opus 5.5 names the writer of 92% of stories and 78% of public reviews by authors it says it knows well, but < 2 % <2\% of texts from authors it says it does not know at all. Increasing reasoning effort helps most when the model says it is only mildly familiar with a person, as thinking does for recalling rare facts ( Calderon et al., 2026 ; Gekhman et al., 2026 ) . Fable 5.2’s accuracy on Redditors it rates very familiar barely changes between low and maximum effort (88% to 89%), while on those it rates a little familiar it rises from 8% to 38% ( Table 6 ).
blocks.zh:
准确性取决于一个模特儿在预训期间可能看到多少文字(Razeghi等人,2022年;Kandpal等人,2023年)。 举例来说, Opus 5.5只识别出20%的作者的故事, 边境模型的预训公司是无法进入的,因此无法对其进行像Infini-gram(Liu等人,2024年)这样的体格检查。 然而,只要问一个前沿模型,它如何了解某人(只知道姓名或用户名)就可以预先预测其准确性。
Opus 5.5将92%的故事和78%的公开评论的作者命名为作者,它说自己很熟悉,但 < 2% < =作者的文本,它说自己根本不了解。 当模型说它只是温和地熟悉一个人时,增加推理努力最有帮助,就像回顾罕见事实的思维一样(Calderon等人,2026年;Gekhman等人,2026年)。 低努力率和最大努力率之间的变化(88 % 至89 % ) , 而低努力率和最大努力率(88%至89 % ) 的精确度从8%上升到38%(表6)。

blocks.en: Prompting frontier models is a simple and effective strategy for authorship detection, one that shows no signs of plateauing as more powerful models trained on larger datasets continue to emerge. Thus, maintaining anonymity (e.g., in peer review or online forums) will continue to get harder, especially if our deliberately minimal setup is combined with web access and cross-platform matching ( Lermen et al., 2026 ) . Defenses are limited: models rarely refuse these queries, deleting one’s online writing does not remove it from the weights of existing models, and rewriting human-authored text with AI only helps partially.
blocks.zh: 快速前沿模型是作者身份探测的简单而有效的战略,没有显示高原化的迹象,因为不断出现对较大数据集进行训练的更强大的模型。 因此,保持匿名性(例如在同行评审或在线论坛上)将继续变得更加困难,特别是如果我们故意将最小设置与网络访问和跨平台匹配结合起来(Lermen等人,2026年)。 辩护是有限的:模型很少拒绝这些查询,删除一个人的在线写作并不能从现有模型的权重中去除,用AI重写人写的文字只会有部分帮助.

blocks.en: 2 Human or AI: who wrote the prose, who had the ideas?
blocks.zh: 2 人或AI:谁写流言,谁有思想?.

blocks.en:
Zero-shot prompting has historically been dismissed as a viable method for detecting AI text, as prior work finds that models have label biases and underperform trained detectors ( Bhattacharjee & Liu, 2024 ; Russell et al., 2025 ) . However, an evaluation published by Vals AI in September 2026 shows that Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra are competitive with commercially available detectors on detecting AI-generated prose ( Fein, 2026 ) . We extend this evaluation by (1) asking whether frontier models can also tell who came up with a text’s ideas , not just who wrote its prose, and (2) measuring how this capability has improved across 72 models released over the past two years ( Figure 2 ). On 36,427 documents from 24 benchmarks, frontier models are competitive with trained detectors such as Pangram 4 ( Glickenhaus et al., 2026 ) at prose detection, in terms of both accuracy and false positive rate. On idea detection, they exceed the accuracy of IdeaLens, the only existing state-of-the-art idea detector ( Rajendhran et al., 2026 ) .
Contamination is an unlikely explanation: though many of these benchmarks were published before the training cutoffs of recently released models, accuracy remains high on texts published after models’ training cutoffs and release dates. Unlike Pangram or IdeaLens, frontier models can also justify their predictions with explanations and quotations, and these explanations are consistent with findings from existing analyses of AI writing. 3 3 3 Claude Fable 5.2 had the highest accuracy on the 860-document sample (94% prose and 97% ideas; Table 1 ), but was not run fully due to cost constraints.
blocks.zh:
" 零射 " 提示在历史上一直被否定为探测AI文本的可行方法,因为先前的工作发现,模型具有标签偏差和未得到充分训练的探测器(Bhattacharjee & Liu,2024;Russell等人,2025年)。 然而,Vals AI在2026年9月发表的一份评价显示,克劳德·奥普斯·5.5和GPT-6 Astra在检测AI生成的散文(Fein,2026)方面与商业上可用的探测器具有竞争力. 我们通过 (1) 询问前沿模型是否还能分辨出文本的理念, 而不仅仅是作者, 在来自24个基准的36,427份文件上,边疆模型与Pangram 4(Glickenhaus等人,2026年)等经过训练的探测器在传言探测上具有竞争力,无论是准确率还是假正率. 在想法探测上,它们超过了IdeaLens的精度,而IdeaLens是现存唯一最先进的想法探测器(Rajendhran等人,2026年).
污染是一个不太可能的解释:虽然这些基准中有许多是在最近发布的模型的培训截止日期之前公布的,但在模型的培训截止日期和发布日期之后发表的文本仍然非常准确。 与Pangram或IdeaLens不同,前沿模型也可以用解释和引文来证明其预测的合理性,这些解释与AI写作的现有分析结论是一致的. 3 3 Claude Fable 5.2在860文档样本中精度最高(94%的传言和97%的想法;表1),但由于成本限制,未能完全运行.

blocks.en: 2.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 2.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Following IdeaLens ( Rajendhran et al., 2026 ) and the cognitive process model of writing ( Flower & Hayes, 1981 ; Hayes, 2012 ) , we define a document’s ideas as what its author decided to say (e.g., its claims, events, and organization), as opposed to the words used to say it (its prose ). A document’s prose and ideas can each come from a person or an AI model, giving the following four cases: Fully human : a person came up with the ideas and wrote the prose. AI ideas, human prose : from a model’s ideas, a person wrote in their own words. Fully AI : a model came up with the ideas and wrote the prose. Human ideas, AI prose : a person came up with the ideas, and a model wrote, rewrote, or polished the prose.
blocks.zh: 按照IdeaLens(Rajendhran等人,2026年)和写作的认知过程模型(Flower & Hayes,1981年;Hayes,2012年),我们定义一个文件的思想是其作者决定说的话(例如其主张,事件,和组织),而不是用来表达的词(它的散文). 文件的散文和想法可以分别来自一个人或AI模型,给出以下四个案例: 个人或AI模式 个人或AI模式 Fully human :一个人想出了这些想法并写了道词. blocks.en: Each model that we evaluate is given the same zero-shot prompt and a single document, with no tools or reference texts. The prompt asks for two judgments on both ideas and prose, along with accompanying information such as key quotes from the document, reasoning for a decision, decisive factors, and an estimate of the share that AI produced from 0 (all human) to 1 (all AI). The exact prompt is in our repository .

blocks.en: Models. We evaluate 72 models from 13 labs, released between July 2024 and November 2026. 4 4 4 We especially focus on Claude Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5 ( Anthropic, 2026c ; Anthropic, 2026e ) , GPT-6 Astra ( OpenAI, 2026b ) and GPT-6.1 Sol ( OpenAI, 2026a ) , Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon ( Gemini Team, 2023 ; Google DeepMind, 2026a ; Google DeepMind, 2026b ) , and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) ; the full list of models is in Table 7 . We choose leading closed- and open-weight models released since July 2024 using the Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI) ( Ho et al., 2025 ) and Artificial Analysis, 5 5 5 https://artificialanalysis.ai/ two standardized aggregated measures of general capabilities.
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 2024年7月至2026年11月期间,我们评估了13个实验室的72个模型. 4,4,我们尤其关注克劳德·寓言5.2和奥普斯5.5(Anthropic,2026c;Anthropic,2026e),GPT-6 Astra(OpenAI,2026b)和GPT-6.1 Sol(OpenAI,2026a),双子座4Argon和Carbon(双子座团队,2023年;Google DeepMind,2026a;Google DeepMind,2026b),以及DeepSeek V4.1 Flash(DeepSek-AI,2026年);完整的模型列表列于表7. 我们使用Epoch能力指数(ECI)(Ho等人,2025年)和人工分析,5 5 5 https://artificialanalysis.ai/ 一般能力的两个标准化汇总度量法,选择2024年7月以来发布的领先的封闭式和开放式模型.

blocks.en:
Data. We pool 37,575 documents from 24 public datasets (§ B.1 ) of peer reviews, student essays, news, fiction, Wikipedia and web text, and academic writing. Most pair human documents with fully AI ones, such as MELD ( Li et al., 2026 ) and StoryScope ( Russell et al., 2026b ) . Some also have models rewrite or polish human documents, like ARB ( Perrone & Romano, 2026 ) , OpAI-Bench ( Bsharat et al., 2026 ) and GEDE ( Gehring & Paaßen, 2025 ) . Finally, the TwiceTold dataset ( Rajendhran et al., 2026 ) has people write stories in their own words from a model’s ideas.
We run a subset of ten models on the full corpus, and evaluate accuracy based on 36,427 documents that all models answered, removing refusals and ambiguous labels (§ B.2 ).
To measure capabilities over time, we run all models on an 860-document sample. Since public datasets may appear in training data, we also evaluate on 200 stories and 1,000 news articles published after models’ knowledge cutoffs (§ 2.3 ).
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 2.2 Results
blocks.zh: 2.2 结果

blocks.en: On all documents (§ B.2 ), GPT-6.1 Sol, Opus 5.5, and Gemini 4 Carbon are competitive with trained detectors, achieving 94–95% accuracy on prose and 89–90% on ideas, compared to 87% for IdeaLens on ideas; on prose, over the three cases Pangram 4.1 is scored on, they reach 98–99% against its 98%.
blocks.zh: 在所有文件(第B.2节)上,GPT-6.1 Sol、Opus 5.5和双子座4 Carbon都与经过训练的探测器竞争,在传言方面达到94-95%的精度,在思想方面达到89-90%的精度,而在思想方面则达到87%;在传言方面,在三种情况下,Pangram 4.1的精度达到98-99 %,而其精度为98%。

blocks.en: Pangram and our benchmarks define AI-edited text differently. Our human-ideas, AI-prose case counts any human text that has passed through an LLM as AI prose, however light the edit: OpAI-Bench’s lightest version changes a median of 2% of words. In contrast, Pangram only labels text as AI-assisted after some threshold of AI editing has been reached, which is determined by soft n-gram matching ( Glickenhaus et al., 2026 , §3.5) . Because the two definitions assign these documents different labels, we do not score Pangram on this case; its prose accuracy is the mean of the other three (calibration in Figure 9 ).
blocks.zh: Pangram和我们的基准对AI编辑的文本定义不同. OPAI-Bench最轻的版本会改变2%的字数的中位数。 相比之下,Pangram只将文本标注为AI编辑达到一定阈值之后的AI辅助文本,由软n-gram匹配决定(Glickenhaus等人,2026年,§3.5). 因为这两个定义为这些文件指定了不同的标签,所以我们不在此例上得分Pangram;它的传言精度是其他三个的平均值(校正图9 ).

blocks.en:
LLMs have near-zero false-positive rates (FPR). In real-world settings—teachers grading essays or books reviewed for prestigious awards—falsely accusing a human writer is far worse than not labeling AI text ( Liang et al., 2023 ) , making a near-zero FPR essential for any serious detector. Based on 9,687 human documents, Pangram 4.1 flags none as AI on prose and Gemini 4 Carbon flags one (0.01%), and Carbon beats IdeaLens on ideas (0.00% against 0.21%) ( Table 10 ); however, the rarity of errors precludes definitive model performance rankings.
FPR does rise on newer text: Carbon flags 0.5% of 812 post-release news articles that Pangram 4.1 labels human ( Table 13 ). These may not be true false positives, since authorship cannot be independently verified and some articles may come from newer models with unfamiliar profiles. Dirty data such as pre-2022 web snippets with AI-written summaries appended or machine-translated web spam (§ B.1 ) and all non-English data are excluded from this set on the suspicion of machine translation involvement.
blocks.zh:
LLMs的假阳性率接近零。 在现实世界中——教师评分论文或书籍,评为著名奖项——诬告人类作家比不标注AI文本(Liang等人,2023年)要糟糕得多,使得任何严肃的探测器都离不开近零的FPR。 根据9,687份人类文件,Pangram 4.1没有标注为关于传言的AI和双子座4碳旗1(0.01%),而Carbon在思想上击败了IdeaLens(0.0%对0.21%)(表10),然而,错误的罕见排除了明确的模型性能排名.
FPR确实在较新的文本上上升:Pangram 4.1标注人类的812篇发布后新闻文章中的碳旗占0.5%(表13)。 这些可能不是真实的假阳性,因为作者身份无法独立核实,有些文章可能来自不熟悉的较新的模型. 诸如2022年前的网络片段带有AI-书面摘要附件或机器翻译的网络垃圾邮件(§B.1)等肮脏数据,以及所有非英语数据因怀疑机器翻译参与而被排除在本集之外.

blocks.en: Model accuracy has improved over time. In the 860-document sample ( Table 11 ), accuracy on both labels climbed from 27% for GPT-4o in 2024 (55% on prose, 54% on ideas) and 59% for GPT-5.2 in 2025 (75%, 80%) to 91% for present-day frontier models (Claude Fable 5.2: 94%, 97%). The best open-weight models still trail, with Kimi K3.1 Pro reaching 63% (83%, 79%). Across the 61 models with an ECI score, accuracy correlates strongly with overall capabilities ( r = 0.94 r=0.94 ; § B.2 ). Newer models are also cheaper than commercial detectors, with Sol costing $27 per 1,000 documents at standard API prices ( Table 7 ) versus $376 on Pangram 4.1 at its standard API price ($0.05 per 100 words). 8 8 8 The average length for a document in our corpus is 751 words. We summarize the available experiment cost records in Table 40 .
blocks.zh: 模型精度随时间推移而提高. 在860文档样本(表11)中,两个标签的准确度从2024年的GPT-4o(55%在传言上,54%在思想上)的27%和2025年的GPT-5.2(75%,80%)的59%上升到现在的前沿模型的91%(Claude Fable 5.2:94%,97%)。 最佳的开放量级模型仍然走在前面,Kimi K3.1 Pro达到了63%(83%,79%). 在有ECI分数的61个模型中,准确度与总体能力密切相关(r=0.94 r=0.94;§B.2)。 较新型的模型也比商业探测器便宜,按标准API价格(表7),Sol每1 000份文件花费27美元,而按标准API价格(每100字0.05美元),Pangram 4.1为376美元。 8,8,8,我们本体中文件的平均长度为751字. 我们总结表40中现有的试验费用记录。

blocks.en: 2.3 Robustness & Explanations
blocks.zh: 2.3 强性与解释

blocks.en: Because these benchmarks are public, the high LLM accuracy could be due to contamination in pretraining data. We explicitly test this by measuring agreement between LLMs and Pangram on texts published after the release dates of all evaluated models. Then, we examine agreement between explanations generated from different models for the same text, and we also compare the explanation content to prior analyses of AI writing.
blocks.zh: 由于这些基准是公开的,所以LLM的高精度可能是由于预训数据中的污染. 我们通过衡量LLMs和Pangram之间在所有评估模型发布日期之后公布的文本上达成的协议来明确检验这一点。 然后,我们审查不同模型为同一文本生成的解释之间的一致,我们还将解释内容与先前对AI写作的分析进行比较.

blocks.en: Detectors maintain high accuracy on post-release documents. Most of our benchmarks are public, so the detectors may have seen them during training. On 200 stories published or generated after the detectors’ training cutoffs, accuracy is only at most 3.4% lower than on the full corpus’s fiction ( Table 14 ). 9 9 9 Both detectors score GPT-6.1 Sol’s stories above Claude Opus 5.5’s, showing minimal effect of recognizing their own writing. Additionally, on 1,000 news articles published after all model releases, frontier models maintain high agreement with Pangram 4.1 (93–98%) and falsely label 0.5–5% of the human-written articles, as classified by Pangram, as AI-written (§ B.3.1 ). Frontier models may struggle more with this data because newer models could have generated these articles.
blocks.zh: 探测器对释放后的文件保持高度准确性。 我们的大多数基准是公开的,因此探测器可能在训练时看到它们. 在探测器的训练截断后发表的或产生的200个故事中,精确度仅比全体虚构(表14)低3.4 % 。 9 9 9 两个探测器都得分GPT-6.1 Sol的故事高于Claude Opus 5.5, 显示承认自己写作的效果微乎其微。 此外,在所有模式发布后发表的1 000篇新闻文章中,前沿模式与Pagram 4.1(93-98%)保持高度一致,并错误地将Pagram归类为AI-writer(第B.3.1节)的人文文章的0.5-5%贴上标签。 边疆模型可能与这些数据有更大的困难,因为较新的模型可能已经产生了这些条款。

blocks.en: In 9.5% of its explanations of fully human (human ideas and human prose) texts, Opus 5.5 argues that the text predates LLMs because of a date in the text (“before 2022”). When it makes this argument on human-ideated, AI-written texts its prose accuracy falls from 80.3% to 35.4%. Replacing every year in 190 dated documents with 2026 changes at most four of Opus 5.5’s, GPT-6.1 Sol’s or Gemini 4 Carbon’s 190 verdicts per attribute, no more than rerunning the same prompt ( Table 15 ). On the other hand, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (open-weight model) changes 29 ideas verdicts to AI and one to human.
blocks.zh: Opus 5.5在其对完全人文(人的思想和人文)文本的9.5%的解释中认为,该文本比LLMs早是因为文本中的日期(2022年之前). 当它用人的思想来提出这个论点时,AI-书面文本的传言精度从80.3%下降到35.4%. 每年在190份注明日期的文件中以2026年的改动取代了最多4份Opus 5.5的GPT-6.1 Sol或双子座4 Carbon的190项裁决,但不超过重播同一提示(表15)。 另一方面,DeepSeek V4.1 Flash(开放量级模型)将29个想法判决改为AI,一个改为人类.

blocks.en:
Taking advantage of LLMs’ capabilities to generate judgments accompanied by explanations ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) , we ask the detectors to disclose the key observations used to make their decisions, where each observation includes quoted evidence, whether it suggests a human or an AI, and why ( Figure 12 ). 10 10 10 The exact prompt is in our repository . This also raises accuracy: Sol gains more than 10 points of idea accuracy on human ideas in AI prose ( Table 12 ).
Across pairs of detectors, the explanations largely cite the same evidence and read it the same way, but agree less on which piece of evidence decided the verdict. 11 11 11 A Claude Opus 5.5 judge, checked against two human annotators, matches the evidence in each pair of explanations on 2,854 documents.
Agreement statistics in § B.3.2 . The cues they cite match prior work ( Table 18 ): hedged assertions point to AI prose and explicitly stated themes and morals to AI ideas ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Russell et al., 2026b ) , while precise factual and technical detail points to human ideas ( Rajendhran et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: 3 Which model wrote the text?
blocks.zh: 3个 是哪个模特儿写的?

blocks.en:
Frontier models can tell whether a human or an AI wrote the text (§ 2 ), but can they tell which model wrote it? Prior work finds that the writing of different LLMs is highly homogeneous ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) , that their stories converge on a shared narrative space ( Russell et al., 2026b ) , and that frontier models from different labs share a dense style that is harder for people to read ( Clark et al., 2026 ) . This convergence makes attributing a text to its source model much more difficult, especially given that there are numerous labs, each with several model versions.
We ask five frontier models
to name the model that wrote each text, with no list of candidates. We find that their errors are consistent with public reports of distillation ( Anthropic, 2026b ; Seetharaman & Arámburo, 2026 ) : for example, the three strongest detectors attribute almost every text by Moonshot’s Kimi K3 to Claude.
blocks.zh:
边疆模型可以分辨是人类还是人工智能撰写的文本(§2),但他们能分辨出是哪个模型撰写的吗? 先前的作品发现不同LLMS的写作高度一致(Jiang et al.,2026;Kim et al.,2026),他们的故事汇合在共同的叙事空间上(Russell et al.,2026b),来自不同实验室的前沿模型有着一种密集的风格,对人们来说更难阅读(Clark et al.,2026). 这种趋同使文本对其源模型的归属更加困难,特别是考虑到实验室众多,每个实验室都有多个模型版本.
我们问五个边疆模式
以命名每个文本的模型,没有候选人名单。 我们发现他们的错误与公开的蒸馏报告(Anthropic, 2026b; Seetharaman & Aránburo, 2026)一致:例如,三个最强的探测器将月光的Kimi K3几乎每个文本都归于克劳德.

blocks.en: We evaluate five frontier models, Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 4 Argon, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. 12 12 12 Each detector is run at medium effort, except DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, which has no medium level and runs at high. Using a minimally modified version of the human vs. AI prompt (§ 2 ), each names the model it thinks wrote the text in a zero-shot setting, without tools or a candidate list. Along with its answer, each detector then gives its key observations, reasoning and decisive factors for its decision in the format of § 2.3 . We score each answer at three levels: the lab (e.g., Anthropic), the model family (e.g., Claude Opus) and the exact model (e.g., Claude Opus 5.5). We report the share of texts attributed correctly at each level.

blocks.en: 3.1 Lab and model attribution
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验室和模型归属

blocks.en:
Identifying a lab is important to understand which provider’s model wrote a text.
Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5 and Argon can identify text from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google with 98% accuracy or more. Opus 5.5 does so even for the two models released after it (Sol and Argon). Their overall accuracy is much lower, at 60%, 50% and 45% ( Table 2 ), because they rarely recognize models from the other eight labs, though Fable 5.2 does so far more often than Opus 5.5 (35% vs. 20%).
Sol and DeepSeek lag far behind at 23% and 11%, and mostly answer OpenAI and Anthropic, so we focus on Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5 and Argon for the rest of this section.
blocks.zh:
确定实验室对于了解哪个供应商的模型写出文本很重要。
寓言5.2,Opus 5.5和Argon可以识别来自OpenAI,Anthropic和Google的文本,精度达到或超过98%. Opus 5.5甚至对于它之后发布的两种型号(Sol和Argon)也是如此. 它们的总体精度要低得多,分别为60%、50%和45%(表2),因为它们很少识别来自其他八个实验室的模型,尽管Fable 5.2迄今为止比Opus 5.5(35%对20%)更频繁。
Sol和DeepSeek以23%和11%的速度远远落后,并且大多回答OpenAI和Anthropic,因此在本节的其余部分我们专注于Fable 5.2,Opus 5.5和Argon.

blocks.en: Even Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5 and Argon rarely name the exact model, and instead name an older model from the same lab. How often they name it depends on how long the model has been public—Opus 5.5 names the exact model for about half of the texts from the three models released before mid-2025, but for none from the 24 models released in 2026. Fable 5.2 does better on the three older models (64%), but names the exact model for only one of 1,792 texts from the 2026 models.
blocks.zh: 即使是Fable 5.2,Opus 5.5和Argon也很少给确切的模型命名,而是给同一个实验室的老模型命名. 他们多久命名它取决于 模型的公开时间 - Opus 5.5命名了2025年中之前发布的3种模型中约一半文本的准确模型,但对于2026年发布的24种模型则没有. 寓言5.2在三种较旧的模型上表现得更好(64%),但只为2026年模型的1,792种文本中的一种命名了确切的模型.

blocks.en:
A model trained on another lab’s outputs can inherit that lab’s style, so a detector may name the lab it learned from. Anthropic has reported distillation attacks on Claude by DeepSeek, Moonshot, and MiniMax ( Anthropic, 2026b ) , and later named Zhipu and Alibaba ( Anthropic, 2026d ) . Consistent with these reports, Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5, and Argon attribute nearly all Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3 texts to Claude (89% or more), even though Fable 5.2 names Moonshot for 93% and 77% for Kimi K2.5 and K2.6 texts, the two releases before K3.
Similarly, Elon Musk testified that xAI “partly” distilled OpenAI models ( Musk v. Altman, 2026 ) and a US advisory says that Alibaba and MiniMax distilled GPT-5 ( National Security Agency et al., 2026 ) : detectors attribute most texts by Grok 4.7, Qwen3.8 Max, MiniMax M3, and M3.1 Flash to GPT. 16 16 16 To check that these patterns are not an artifact of our detectors falling back to a known lab for models released after knowledge cutoff, we also run a stylometric analysis, and find the same shifts, even after removing the information-dense style shared by recent models ( Clark et al., 2026 ) (§ C.3 ).
blocks.zh:
在另一个实验室的输出上受过训练的模型可以继承该实验室的风格,因此一个探测器可以命名它从中吸取的实验室. Anthropic报道了DeepSeek,Moonshot,以及MiniMax(Anthropic,2026b)对克劳德的蒸馏攻击,后来命名为Zhipu和Alibaba(Anthropic,2026d). 根据这些报告,Fable 5.2,Opus 5.5和Argon将几乎所有的Kimi K3和GLM-5.3文本都归于克劳德(89%或以上),尽管Fable 5.2名称Moonshot为93%,Kimi K2.5和K2.6文本为77%,但这两个版本在K3之前发布.
同样,伊隆 Musk作证说,xAI“部分”蒸馏了OpenAI模型(Musk诉Altman,2026年),美国的一项咨询说,Alibaba和MiniMax蒸馏了GPT-5(国家安全局等,2026年): 探测器将Grok 4.7, Quen3.8 Max, MiniMax M3, 和 M3.1 Flash 的文本大多归为GPT. 16 16 为检查这些模式不是我们探测器在知识截断后释放的模型返回到已知实验室的文物,我们还进行了定型分析,发现同样的变化,即使在删除了最近模型共享的信息密集样式(Clark等人, 2026年)(§C.3)之后也是如此。

blocks.en: 3.2 Model writing profiles
blocks.zh: 3.2 示范写作简介

blocks.en: Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5 and Argon tell the big three labs apart almost perfectly, but what do they think each lab reads like? Each detector explains its answer for every text (§ 3 ), so we can pool explanations into a writing profile of each lab. 17 17 17 We group explanations into cues and keep those the detector notes on a lab’s texts significantly more often than on any other lab’s (§ C.3 ). We treat the other eight labs as one lab.
blocks.zh: 寓言5.2,Opus 5.5和Argon将三个实验室几乎完全分开,但他们认为每个实验室都读什么? 每个探测器解释每个文本的答案(§3),所以我们可以将解释汇集到每个实验室的写作简介中. 17 17 我们把解释分成几个提示,并将探测器笔记放在实验室的文本上比其他实验室的文本要多得多(第C.3节)。 我们把其他八个实验室当成一个实验室。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Opus 5.5 and Argon agree on what sets each lab’s writing apart. Each cell gives examples of the cues a detector often cites for that lab, using only texts where it names the right lab. Highlighted cues are often cited by both detectors. Full model profiles can be found here .
blocks.zh: 表3:Opus 5.5和Argon就每个实验室的书写方式达成一致。 每个细胞给出一个探测器经常为实验室引用的提示的例子,只使用它命名为右实验室的文本. 两个探测器经常引用突出的提示. 完整的模型简介可在此找到.

blocks.en:
The detectors describe the big three labs in largely the same way ( Table 3 ). 18 18 18 We show only cues that a detector cites on at least 25% of a lab’s texts within a domain (stories, news, op-eds), and at least 15 points and 1.5 times more often than on any other lab’s texts. GPT hedges its claims, flags gaps instead of inventing specifics, and leans on aphorisms. Claude treats opposing views charitably, writes with dry wit, and ends quietly. Gemini stacks adjectives and piles on intensifiers and stock clichés, and invents named sources and quotes in its news articles.
All three also tie the same punctuation habits to each lab, though Fable 5.2 and Argon cite them more than twice as often as Opus 5.5. GPT uses curly quotes and drops the Oxford comma, Gemini mixes curly and straight quotes, and Claude puts spaces around its dashes. For Claude, Opus 5.5 and Argon tend to identify different traits, while Fable 5.2 finds most of both.
blocks.zh:
探测器对三大实验室的描述大致相同(表3 ) 。 18 18 我们只显示一个探测器引用了至少25 % 的实验室域内文本(故事、新闻、专栏版),至少15点,是其他实验室文本的1.5倍。 GPT对其主张进行套期,旗帜空白而不是发明具体内容,并倚靠形容词. Claude对对立观点的处理令人发指,用干燥的智慧写作,然后悄悄结束. 双子座堆放形容词和堆放强化词和股票陈词滥调,在其新闻文章中发明了命名来源和引用.
这三个也都把相同的点球习惯与每个实验室联系在一起,虽然Fable 5.2和Argon引用它们的次数是Opus 5.5的两倍以上. GPT使用卷曲引号并放下牛津逗号,双子座混合卷曲和直截了当的引号,克劳德将空格置于其破折号周围. 对于克劳德来说,Opus 5.5和Argon倾向于识别不同的特征,而Fable 5.2则发现了大部分两者.

blocks.en:
A detector may attribute a text to a lab either because the text shares that lab’s traits or because the detector does not recognize the model that wrote it and falls back to a known lab.
For most open-model texts attributed to Claude it is the latter: the detectors cite few of the traits that set Claude apart. Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3 are the exception. All three detectors note the same dry wit in their texts as in Claude’s. Opus 5.5 also notes Claude’s bookend endings and closing quotations, and Argon notes the same spaced dashes and parenthetical asides. The detectors find all of these far less often in earlier Kimi and GLM models’ texts. 19 19 19 Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon attribute most Kimi K2 texts (88% and 93%) and nearly all Kimi K3 texts to Claude, but they find far more of Claude’s traits in K3’s texts than in K2’s. Likewise, Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5 also find several of GPT’s traits in Grok 4.7, Qwen3.8 Max, MiniMax M3 and M3.1 Flash texts, with little to no Claude traits.
blocks.zh:
检测器可能将文本归属于实验室,要么是因为文本与实验室的特征相同,要么是因为检测器不承认写出文本的模型,而回到已知的实验室.
对于大部分可归结于克劳德的开放模型文本,后者是:探测器引用的将克劳德分开的特征很少. Kimi K3和GLM-5.3是例外. 所有三个探测器在文本中都注意到与克劳德一样的干劲。 Opus 5.5也注意到克劳德的书尾结局和收尾引文,Argon也注意到同样的空格和括号边。 探测器在早期的Kimi和GLM模型的文本中发现这些文本的频率要低得多。 19 19 19 Claude Opus 5.5和双子座4 Argon将大部分Kimi K2文本(88%和93%)和几乎所有Kimi K3文本都归于Claude,但他们发现K3文本中Claude的特征远多于K2。 同样,Fable 5.2和Opus 5.5在Grok 4.7、Quen3.8 Max、MiniMax M3和M3.1中也发现了GPT的几个特征。 闪电短信, 几乎没有或没有克劳德的特征。

blocks.en: 4 Which human wrote the text?
blocks.zh: 页:1 是谁写的?

blocks.en: While the space of plausible outputs in the model attribution task is just a few dozen models, naming the person behind a human-written text is an open-world task with countless possible outputs ( Koppel et al., 2011 ; Luyckx & Daelemans, 2011 ) and much less data available per author. To evaluate this capability while mitigating the confound of data contamination, we collect 3,541 texts from five domains, each either private (never posted publicly) or recent (published after each tested model’s knowledge cutoff, and after most of their release dates). Even so, frontier models unmask many authors across all of these domains from just a single text, given a minimally modified prompt from the previous sections and no tools, web access, or candidate lists. The best-performing model we test is Claude Fable 5.2, which names the reviewer of 56% of private peer reviews and the username behind 31% of recent Reddit comments. Paraphrasing a human text with AI is only a partial defense, as content-related cues persist.
blocks.zh: 虽然模型归属任务中可信产出的空间只有几十个模型,但命名人文文字背后的人是一项开放世界的任务,可能产出不计其数(Koppel等人,2011年;Luyckx & Daelemans,2011年)。 为了评估这一能力,同时减轻数据污染的混乱,我们从五个领域收集了3,541份文本,每个领域都是私人(从未公开发布)或最近(在每个测试模型的知识断层之后发表,大多数发布日期之后发表)的。 即使如此,前沿模型从一个单一的文本中解析了所有这些领域的许多作者,因为前几节的提示是最小的,没有工具、网络访问或候选名单。 我们测试的最佳表现模式是Claude Fable 5.2,它命名了56%的私人同行评论的审查者,以及最近Reddit评论的31%后面的用户名. 将人文文字与AI作比喻只是部分辩护,因为与内容相关的提示依然存在.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: Given a single text and a minimally modified version of the prompt from previous sections, models return the human author’s name (or username for Reddit), a list of supporting observations, and a confidence level. Unlike Lermen et al. (2026) , who augment LLMs with web search and candidate pools to match users across platforms, we provide no tools, web access, or candidate lists. To keep personal account information out of the models’ context, we query every model through an API, not a chat app or coding CLI ( Table 24 ). 20 20 20 There were a few exceptions run through the Claude Code CLI due to budget considerations, though only when familiarity with the CLI account holder was unlikely to impact accuracy, including the Reddit reasoning-effort comparison ( Table 6 ), as well as Opus 5.5’s name-only familiarity ratings of Reddit accounts and Nature reviewers. In an early run, we observed the Claude Code CLI quote the account user’s email when attributing a text the account owner wrote, a phenomenon studied in Zhong et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 由于一个单一的文本和前几节对提示的最小修改版本,模型返回了人类作者的名字(或Reddit的用户名),一个支持观察的列表,以及一个信任级别. 与Lermen等人(2026年)不同的是,他们通过网络搜索和候选集合来增加LLMS,以匹配跨平台的用户,我们没有提供工具,网络访问,也没有提供候选名单. 为了让个人账户信息远离模型的背景,我们通过API而不是聊天应用或编码CLI(表24)来查询每个模型。 20 20 20 由于预算方面的考虑,通过Claude Code CLI有少数例外,尽管只有在熟悉CLI账户持有者不太可能影响准确性的情况下,包括Reddit推理-效果比较(表6),以及Opus 5.5对Reddit账户和自然评论员的仅名的熟悉评级。 在早期的运行中,我们观察到Claude Code CLI引用账户用户的电子邮件,

blocks.en: We collect four datasets of publicly available writing published online after September 22, 2026, the release date of Claude Opus 5.5. Since a model’s reported knowledge cutoff generally applies only to pretraining and not post-training, only data published after a model’s release date is completely safe from contamination. 22 22 22 By design, Claude Opus 5.5 is completely free from training data contamination in our experiments. Eight percent of public data is from before GPT-6.1 Sol release, 23% is before Gemini 4 Argon, and 28% before DeepSeek V4.1 Flash; pre-release data stems only from stories and public peer reviews. Claude Fable 5.2 was released about 10 days after all public data collection completed, and its knowledge cutoff is June 2026.

blocks.en: We benchmark four frontier models from Anthropic (Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5), OpenAI (GPT-6.1 Sol), and Google (Gemini 4 Argon), as well as one open-weight model with accessible chain-of-thought (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash). 23 23 23 All models run at the provider’s default reasoning effort: Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol and Gemini 4 Argon at medium and Claude Fable 5.2 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at high. See § 5 for how reasoning affects detection, and Table 26 for results with Gemini 4 Carbon. We report exact match accuracy (after normalizing titles, accents, and punctuation) for each dataset. For NLP papers, we consider a prediction correct if the model names any co-author, while confirmed pen-names are verified and counted as correct for fiction. For Reddit texts, we use a slightly modified prompt to ask specifically for usernames. For public reviews and NLP papers, accuracy is reported on texts that Pangram 4.1 does not label AI (human and mixed labels), unless otherwise specified.
blocks.zh: 我们以Anthropic(5.2,Opus 5.5),OpenAI(GPT-6.1 Sol)和Google(Gemini 4 Argon)的4个前沿模型以及一个可访问思维链的开放量模型(DeepSeek V4.1 Flash)作为基准。 23 23 所有模型运行在提供者默认推理努力中:Claude Opus 5.5,GPT-6.1 Sol和双子座4 Argon在中和Claude Fable 5.2和DeepSeek V4.1。 闪耀在高处。 见关于推理如何影响检测的第5节,关于双子座4碳的结果,见表26。 我们报告每个数据集的精确匹配准确性(在标题、重音和标点正常化之后)。 对NLP论文来说,我们认为,如果模型名称是任何共同作者,而确认的笔名被核实并算作是虚构的正确,那么预测是正确的. 对于 Reddit 文本,我们使用一个稍作修改的提示来专门询问用户名. 对于公众评论和NLP论文,除非另有说明,否则Pangram 4.1不标注AI(人和混合标签)的文本要报告准确性.

blocks.en: 4.2 Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 结果

blocks.en: Despite the difficulty of this task, frontier models are surprisingly effective on both private and recent datasets, and they are rapidly improving. Fable 5.2, the best performing model in all domains ( Figure 4 ), exhibits considerable gains over Opus 5.5, which was released less than two months prior.
blocks.zh: 尽管这一任务有困难,但前沿模型在私人和最近数据集方面都令人惊讶地有效,并且正在迅速改进。 功能5.2是所有领域的最佳表现模式(图4),它比Opus 5.5有相当大的收益,而Opus 5.5是在不到两个月前发布的。

blocks.en: On private peer reviews, Fable 5.2 leads with 56% accuracy, while on public reviews from the Nature journal family it reaches 78%. The private reviews consist of 266 standard reviews and 132 meta-reviews, the latter of which are much shorter in length, come from two authors, and are harder to attribute. Fable 5.2 names the writer of 68% of reviews but only 31% of meta-reviews. Opus 5.5 and Argon also have twice the accuracy on standard reviews as on meta-reviews ( Table 32 ). DeepSeek, the only open model, performs very poorly in all domains despite reporting the highest average confidence levels; its chain-of-thought reveals no clear reasoning insights and consists primarily of hedging and indecision.
blocks.zh: 在私人同行评审方面,第5.2条线索准确度达到56%,而在《自然》杂志家庭的公开评审方面则达到78%。 私人评论包括266项标准评论和132项元评论,后者长度要短得多,来自两位作者,更难归属. 寓言5.2将编剧命名为68%的评论,但只有31%的元评论. Opus 5.5和Argon标准审查的准确性是元审查的两倍(表32)。 DeepSeek是唯一的开放模式,尽管报告的平均信心水平最高,但在所有领域表现非常差;其思维链没有显示明确的推理洞察力,主要包括套期保值和无决定。

blocks.en: People do not have to be well-known or even publish under their real name to be detected. Models can detect Reddit usernames from comments without any additional context: Fable 5.2 identifies the Reddit user behind 31% of comments, nearly double Opus 5.5 which identifies 17%. Accuracy varies greatly based on subreddit: Fable 5.2 names 79% of comments in r/cpp and 50% in r/ProgrammingLanguages, but only 13% in r/AskAnthropology. This may also reflect training data sampling procedures from frontier labs, as subreddits about programming might be valuable to improve coding performance. As discussed in § 5 , pseudonymity is especially fragile for active users in niche communities. Fable 5.2 names 26% of the 860 users at least once (§ D.3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 人们不需要名声大噪,甚至用自己的真名发表才能被发现. 模型可以在没有任何附加上下文的情况下从注释中检测 Reddit 用户名 : 寓言5.2识别出31%的评论背后的Reddit用户,近两倍的Opus 5.5识别出17%的评论. 准确度根据下排差异很大:在r/cpp中Fable 5.2名字为79%的评论,在r/ProgrammingLanguages中为50%的评论,但在r/AskAnthropology中只有13%的评论. 这也可能反映来自前沿实验室的培训数据取样程序,因为关于编程的子编辑对于改进编码性能可能很有价值。 如第5节所述,假名对于特殊社区的积极用户特别脆弱。 有线5.2至少一次将860个用户中的26%命名(第D.3.2节).

blocks.en:
Each model’s prediction includes a confidence level. Claude models tend to understate theirs. On public data, Fable 5.2’s mean reported confidence is 17% while achieving 27% accuracy. When Fable 5.2’s confidence is 25% or more (25% of responses), its predictions are 87% correct ( Figure 17 ). Furthermore, confident mistakes are rare. Of all Fable 5.2 answers, 0.3% report both at least 80% confidence and name the wrong person; the corresponding percents are 0.4% for Opus 5.5, 3.3% for Argon, and 5.1% for DeepSeek.
The threat to anonymity therefore is greater than the accuracy levels suggest; one can rely on the strongest model’s confident answers and be right almost every time.
blocks.zh:
每个模型的预测包括一个信任水平。 克劳德模型往往会低调地描述自己的. 在公共数据方面,Fable 5.2的平均报告信心为17%,而准确性为27%。 当寓言5.2的置信度为25%或以上(25%的答复)时,其预测是正确的87%(图17)。 此外,自信的错误很少见。 在所有"寓言5.2"的回答中,0.3%的回答同时报告至少80%的置信度和给错人取名;相应的百分比是Opus 5.5的0.4%,Argon的3.3%,DeepSeek的5.1%.
因此,匿名威胁大于精确度;人们可以依赖最强模型的自信答案,而且几乎每次都正确。

blocks.en: Models do well on our private dataset, whose authorship was never made public. In fact, Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5, and Argon perform better on our private dataset than on the public Reddit comments and stories. All of the public data is posted after the release date of Opus 5.5, which correctly names an author of 43% of recent NLP papers 24 24 24 43% is Opus 5.5’s accuracy on the 90 non-AI written papers as labeled by Pangram. Opus 5.5 names 35% of all 120 papers. and the usernames behind 17% of Reddit comments. Accuracy instead correlates with training data exposure and familiarity, which we discuss in § 5 .
blocks.zh: 模型在我们的私人数据集上做得很好,其作者身份从未公开. 事实上,Fable 5.2,Opus 5.5和Argon在我们私人数据集上的表现优于公众Reddit的评论和故事. 所有公共数据都在Opus 5.5发布日期后发布,该数据正确命名了近代NLP论文24 24 24 43 %的作者,是Pangram标注的90份非AI书面论文上的Opus 5.5的准确性. Opus 5.5将所有120篇论文的35%命名. 和 Reddit 注释的17% 后面的用户名。 相反,准确性与培训数据的曝光和熟悉程度相关,我们在第5节对此进行了讨论。

blocks.en: Since our prompt explicitly requests a human author’s name, models perform poorly on texts across the four recent datasets that Pangram 4.1 labels as AI-generated. The discrepancy is most noticeable in public peer reviews and papers that increasingly contain AI-written text ( Liang et al., 2024 ; Emi, 2025 ; Naddaf, 2025 ) . Pangram flags 770 of the 1,559 public reviews as AI-generated, and models name the author of only 1–4% of these reviews ( Table 27 ). Omitting AI-generated texts, visualized with the striped bars in Figure 4 , raises accuracy on public reviews by 75–87% for every model (Opus 5.5 rises from 15% to 28%), and raises it on papers. The remaining domains have negligible numbers of AI-generated texts.
blocks.zh: 包括Pangram 4.1标签为AI的最近四个数据集, 这一差异在公开同行评审和越来越多地包含AI书面文本的论文中最为明显(梁等人,2024年;Emi,2025年;Naddaf,2025年)。 在作为AI生成的1,559份公开评论中,Pangram旗为770份,模型只将其中1-4%的评论作者命名(表27). 用图4中条纹条直观显示的人工智能生成的文本, 其余域的AI生成文本数量微不足道.

blocks.en: The correlation between length and accuracy is strongest for public reviews and stories, the latter of which has the widest range of lengths (181-20,947 words). Fable 5.2 identifies only 13.8% of 29 stories under 500 words and 43.3% of 30 over 4K words ( Figure 5 ). These results align with findings in AI-text detection, where shorter texts are harder to detect ( Emi & Spero, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 长度和准确度之间的关联性对于公众评论和故事来说最强,后者的长度范围最广(181-20,947字). 寓言5.2只识别出500字以下的29个故事中的13.8%,30个以上4K字中的43.3%(图5). 这些结果与AI文本检测结果一致,其中文本较短更难检测(Emi & Spero, 2024年)。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Author attribution accuracy increases with number of words in a text. Tick labels are the upper limit of each length bin.
blocks.zh: 图5:作者归属准确性随着文本中的词数的增加而增加. 勾选标签是每个长度桶的上限.

blocks.en: We test the stability of Fable 5.2 predictions on Reddit comments over five independent runs. Overall accuracy stays nearly identical, between 29.9–31.1%, though there is some variation in predictions. Only 32.6% of comments receive the same author prediction every time. When predictions change, it is usually from one wrong answer to another; 63.2% of comments are predicted incorrectly in all five runs, while 25% are predicted correctly in all five runs. Familiar authors are predicted far more reliably. Fable 5.2 is correct in all five runs for 92.7% of the 96 comments from the 39 most familiar users (rated 3), but for only 0.4% of 281 comments from completely unfamiliar users (rated 0). Accuracy remains stable over other domains as well; see § D.4.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们在Reddit评论上测试5.2号线的稳定性, 总体准确度基本相同,在29.9-31.1 %之间,尽管预测有一定差异. 每次只有32.6%的评论收到相同的作者预测. 当预测发生变化时,通常从一个错误的答案到另一个错误的答案;63.2%的评论在所有五个运行中都是不正确的预测,而25%的预测在所有五个运行中都是正确的. 对熟悉的作者的预测要可靠得多。 在39个最熟悉的用户(评分3)的96条评论中,5.2号线在所有5条运行中都正确,但281条评论中只有0.4%来自完全不熟悉的用户(评分0). 准确性在其他领域也保持稳定;见D.4.3节。

blocks.en: 4.3 What aspects of the text give authors away?
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 文本的哪些方面会让作者离开?

blocks.en: We analyze the generated explanations to see which features of the text each model relies on when naming the author. Generally, the explanations cover both the text’s content as well as its writing style. For instance, when identifying the author of the short story “Lost Child” (published in “The New Yorker” magazine in September 2026), Fable 5.2 cites “this particular pairing of syntax and subject matter” as decisive factors when correctly predicting Joyce Carol Oates ( Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们分析生成的解释,看看每个模型在命名作者时所依赖的文本的哪些特征. 一般来说,解释既包括案文的内容,也包括其写作风格。 例如,Fable 5.2在指认短篇故事“迷失的孩子”(2026年9月在《纽约人》杂志上发表)的作者时,在正确预测乔伊斯·卡罗尔·奥特斯(表5)时将“语法和主题的这种特定的对称”作为决定性因素。

blocks.en: Reviewers often cite their own papers in their reviews, and these self-citations have historically been used to identify authors under blind review ( Matsubara & Singh, 2020 ; Caragea et al., 2019 ; Le Goues et al., 2018 ) . Of the 1,559 public reviews, only 106 cite the reviewer’s own work (82 explicitly list reviewer’s name in citation, 24 do not). On these reviews, Fable 5.2 names the reviewer 80% of the time, compared with 17% of reviews without a self-citation ( Table 4 ).
blocks.zh: 评论家在评论中经常引用自己的论文,这些自述在历史上被用来识别被盲目审查的作者(Matsubara & Singh,2020年;Caragea等人,2019年;Le Goues等人,2018年). 在1,559份公开评论中,只有106份引述了审查员自己的作品(引文中有82份明确列出审查员的姓名,24份没有)。 在这些审查中,Fable 5.2指定了80%的审查者,而17%的审查没有自我引用(表4)。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Accuracy is higher for more active Reddit users and authors with many Goodreads ratings. Left: Reddit commenters, binned by total number of posts and comments in the subreddit over the previous 12 months. Right: authors, binned by the total number of Goodreads ratings across their books; “None” indicates authors without a Goodreads profile (69/187).
blocks.zh: 图6:对于更活跃的Reddit用户和拥有许多Goodreads收视率的作者来说,准确度更高. 左:Reddit评论员,在之前的12个月里被子编辑中以总的帖子数和评论数来宾. 右:作者,被全书Goodreads的收视总数所收视;"无"表示作者没有Goodreads简介(69/187).

blocks.en: Table 4 : Accuracy (%) with and without self-citations in the text; bold marks the best per column in each group. Self-citation is an obvious clue to author identity, but models still name writers without them. The first row of each group is accuracy on all its texts; the indented rows below are accuracy on subsets, with and without self-citations.
blocks.zh: 表 4: 准确度(%),在文本中有无自我引用;粗体标出每栏中的最佳值。 自引用是作者身份的明显线索,但模型仍然没有他们的名字作家. 每组的第一行是其所有文本的准确性;下面的缩进行是子集的准确性,有和没有自我引用.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Claude Fable 5.2 bases each decision on concrete evidence ranging from mixed apostrophes to a reviewer’s self-description. Each explanation lists quoted evidence and names decisive factors. In each row, a highlighted reason shares its color with the words in the text it describes.
blocks.zh: 表5:Claude Fable 5.2根据具体证据作出每项决定,从混合假设到审查者的自我描述不等。 每一份解释都列出了引用的证据和决定性因素。 在每行中,一个突出的原因与它所描述的文字中的单词分享其颜色.

blocks.en: A model could name the author of a paper by knowing who works on its topic, without recognizing anyone’s writing. To measure how far topic knowledge alone contributes, we take the 34 cs.CL papers posted to arXiv after Opus 5.5’s training cutoff that Pangram 4.1 labels human. Opus 5.5 receives either five keywords describing each paper’s topic or its title and abstract, and is asked to name two researchers (early career and senior) who work on the problem. It is explicitly told that it is not being asked who wrote the paper. A given name is correct if it is any of that paper’s co-authors ( Table 35 ). We compare the minimal topic inputs with our default method of giving the full main text. Topic keywords identify an author for only 12% of papers, against 53% from the title and abstract and 76% from the full text. Across all 120 papers, including those Pangram labels mixed or AI, the full-text variant names the senior author of 35%.
blocks.zh: 一个模型可以通过知道谁在研究论文,而不承认任何人的著作来命名论文的作者。 为了衡量单是专题知识贡献多大,我们采取34个cs. 在Opus 5.5的训练停课后, Opus 5.5收到5个关键词,说明每篇论文的主题或其标题和抽象,并被要求点出两位研究者(早期的职业生涯和高级的)的名字来研究这个问题。 有人明确告知,没有人问该文件是谁写的。 如果某个文件的合著者之一,其名称是正确的(表35)。 我们把最低限度的专题投入与提供全文的默认方法进行比较。 专题关键词只为12%的论文指明作者,而标题和摘要为53%,全文为76%。 在包括Pangram标签或AI在内的120篇论文中,全文变体将高级作者命名为35%。

blocks.en: 5 Who can be identified?
blocks.zh: 页:1 谁能辨识.

blocks.en: In this section, we look at what makes certain authors (AI or human) recognizable. We observe that the common factor is exposure in the training data. Detectors are most accurate on the writers they have plausibly seen most during training. We first show how this holds across our three research questions and then introduce a measure of familiarity that works without access to pretraining data. We use this measure to explore how reasoning effort and paraphrasing change who can be identified. Finally, we discuss the broader implications of our experiments for anonymity.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们审视了哪些作者(AI或人类)可以认出来。 我们注意到,共同因素是培训数据中的暴露。 探测器最精确地记录了他们在训练期间最有名望的作家。 我们首先说明这如何贯穿我们三个研究问题,然后提出一种不使用预培训数据的熟悉度。 我们利用这一措施来探讨如何进行推理努力和解释哪些人可以被确定的变化。 最后,我们讨论了我们实验对匿名性的广泛影响。

blocks.en: 5.1 Exposure and familiarity
blocks.zh: 5.1 接触和熟悉

blocks.en:
Exposure in pretraining data is a plausible common contributor to performance across all author attribution settings.
For AI text detection (§ 2 ), models now train on a web in which a large share of text is machine-written, which likely improves their ability to detect it. For instance, 31.1% of quality-filtered web tokens from August 2026 are labeled as AI-generated ( Russell et al., 2026a ) . For attribution among models (§ 3 ), detectors name OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google far more reliably than the other eight labs. This is consistent with the model market share reported by Pangram ( Masrour, 2026 ) . 25 25 25 We note that this gap is also consistent with distillation from larger labs, and it is likely that both exposure and distillation contribute to weaker performance on these labs’ models. The rest of this section focuses on what makes human authors identifiable: we test several proxies for exposure (e.g., mentions of their names in open pretraining corpora, comment activity on Reddit, visibility and seniority) and find that directly prompting the model for its familiarity with a person correlates most strongly with how identifiable their texts are.
blocks.zh:
接触培训前数据是所有作者归属环境业绩的一个合理共同贡献。
对于AI文本检测(§2),模型现在在一个网络上进行训练,其中很大一部分文本是机器写的,这有可能提高它们检测它的能力. 例如,从2026年8月起,31.1%的质量过滤的网络标志被标注为AI生成(Russell等人,2026a) 。 。 。 对于模型之间的归属(§ 3),探测器命名OpenAI,Anthropic,和Google远比其他八个实验室更可靠. 这与Pangram(Masrour, 2026年)报告的模型市场份额一致. 25 25 我们注意到,这一差距也与大型实验室的蒸馏一致,接触和蒸馏都可能导致这些实验室模型的性能下降. 本节的其余部分着重说明是什么使人类作者可以识别:我们测试了几个接触代理人(例如,在开放的预训公司中提及他们的名字,评论Reddit的活动,知名度和资历),并发现直接促使模型对一个人的熟悉与其文本的可识别性关系最为密切。

blocks.en: In § 4 , we define domain-specific measures for human author visibility ( Figure 6 ). On Reddit, we measure visibility by a user’s post and comment count in a given subreddit over the past 12 months. Using this metric, Claude Fable 5.2’s attribution accuracy rises from 2% for inactive users to 13% for those with 1–50 posts, reaching 69% for users with over 500 posts. Over the same span, Claude Opus 5.5’s accuracy increases from 0% to 36%. For stories, we use the total number of Goodreads ratings across an author’s books. Here, Fable 5.2 identifies 4% of stories by authors without a Goodreads profile, 50% by those with 1k–10k ratings, and 100% by authors with over 10k ratings. Similarly, Opus 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon, and GPT-6.1 Sol fail to identify any authors without a profile, but successfully attribute 96% of those with over 1M ratings. A similar trend holds for private reviews ( Table 32 ). Opus 5.5 and Argon correctly identify the two most senior reviewers on 66% and 71% of their 174 ordinary reviews, respectively, compared to 23% and 14% across the 92 reviews written by the other four contributors.
blocks.zh: 在《宪法》第4条中,我们界定了针对特定领域的人类作者可见度的措施(图6)。 在Reddit上, 我们用用户的帖子测量可见度, 用这一衡量标准,Claude Fable 5.2的归属精确度从不活跃用户的2%上升到了1–50个员额的13%,到500多个员额的用户的69%。 克劳德·奥普斯(Claude Opus)5.5的准确度也从0%提高到36%。 对于故事,我们使用作者的书籍中Goodreads的收视总数。 在这里,Fable 5.2识别出没有Goodreads简介的作者占故事的4%,收视率1k–10k的作者占50%,收视率超过10k的作者占100%. 同样,Opus 5.5、双子座4 Argon和GPT-6.1 Sol无法识别任何没有剖面描述的作者,但成功将96%的评分超过1M的作者归属. 私人审查也有类似趋势(表32)。 Opus 5.5和Argon正确确定了174次普通审查中分别有66%和71%的两名最高级审查者,而其他4名撰稿者撰写的92次审查中分别有23%和14%。

blocks.en: Language models can retrieve details about entities like writers and public figures from their parametric memory ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ; Yin et al., 2023 ; Ferrando et al., 2025 ) . Because the pretraining data of frontier models is unavailable to inspect directly, we elicit this knowledge by prompting the model to rate its familiarity with a name or username on a 0–3 scale (see our repository for prompt; § D.4.1 ). We make two independent calls and average results to compute self-reported familiarity , which strongly corresponds with attribution accuracy. Opus 5.5 and Argon identify 1.3–4.2% of texts by writers they rate 0, compared to 57.7–60.8% of texts by writers they rate 3. About 90% of Opus 5.5’s successful attributions and 79% of Argon’s come from writers rated ≥ 1.5 \geq 1.5 , who account for 45% and 30% of texts, respectively ( Table 33 ). The rating also transfers across models, with one model’s familiarity score predicting another model’s accuracy ( Table 34 ). These results mirror factual recall, where obscure entities are recalled less often ( Mallen et al., 2023 ; Kandpal et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 语言模型可以从他们的参数记忆中检索关于作家和公共人物等实体的细节(Kadavath等人,2022年;Yin等人,2023年;Ferrando等人,2025年)。 由于无法直接检查前沿模型的预训数据,我们通过促使模型按0至3级对名称或用户名的熟悉程度进行评分(见我们的存储库;第D.4.1节)。 我们发出两个独立的呼吁和平均结果来计算自报的熟悉程度,这与归属的准确性非常吻合。 Opus 5.5和Argon确定1.3-4.2%的作者评为0,而57.7-60.8%的作者评为0。 3个 Opus 5.5的成功归属和Argon的79%来自被评为 \\ 1.5\geq 1.5 的作家,他们分别占文本的45%和30%(表33)。 评级也跨模型转移,一个模型的熟悉度得分预测另一个模型的准确性(表34)。 这些结果反映了对事实的回顾,其中模糊的实体被召回的次数较少(Mallen等人,2023年;Kandpal等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Where we can compare them directly, a model’s familiarity rating predicts attribution better than other domain-specific visibility measures. On Reddit, Opus 5.5’s rating separates the Reddit accounts it does and does not identify with an AUC of 0.89, compared to 0.78 for posting activity over the prior 12 months. Even among accounts with similar posting activity, Opus 5.5 identifies 17–56% of those it rates familiar ( ≥ \geq 1.5 average rating), compared to at most 14% of the rest.
blocks.zh: 在我们能够直接比较它们的地方,一个模型的熟悉度评级比其他特定域的能见度衡量标准更能预测归属. 在Reddit上,Opus 5.5的评级将Reddit的账户分开,没有将AUC的账号定为0.89,而前12个月张贴活动的账号为0.78。 Opus 5.5 确定在熟悉的账户中的比例为 17-56% (\\\\\\ 1.5 平均评级),而其他账户的比例最多为14%。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Models are more likely to name authors they are familiar with. Familiarity is the model’s self-reported rating from 0–3. Solid dots on lines are original texts; hollow dots show average accuracy of two paraphrased versions.
blocks.zh: 图7:模型更可能指代自己熟悉的作者. 熟悉度是模型自报的0–3的评级. 线上的固体点是原始文本;空心点显示平均精确度为两个解译版本.

blocks.en:
We collect 442 comments from 216 Reddit accounts, sampled across all familiarity levels, and group accounts by each model’s own rating. Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5, and Argon all show their largest accuracy gains from reasoning on accounts rated a little familiar , +35.8, +21.4, and +12.4 points, respectively ( Table 6 ). For Fable 5.2, accuracy on these 19 accounts increases from 8.4% at low effort to 44.2% at max,
with most of the improvement coming at the highest setting. Fable 5.2 names about 90% of very familiar accounts at every effort level, and no unfamiliar accounts until max effort, where it reaches 8%. Higher reasoning can recover weakly memorized data, similar to factual question answering, where thinking helps models recall rare facts more than popular ones ( Calderon et al., 2026 ; Gekhman et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们从216个Reddit账户中收集了442条评论,从所有熟悉的级别进行抽样,从每个模型自己的评级中收集团体账户。 寓言5.2,Opus 5.5,和Argon都显示出它们从对一些稍为熟悉的账户的推理中获得的最大准确性收益,分别是+35.8,+21.4和+12.4分(表6)。 就5.2号寓言而言,这19个账户的准确性从低努力的8.4%提高到最高努力的44.2%。
大部分改进都是在最高环境进行的 有线5.2在每一个工作级别上都列出了大约90%的非常熟悉的账户,在最大努力达到8%之前,没有不熟悉的账户。 更高的推理可以恢复微弱的记忆性数据,类似于事实问题回答,思维可以帮助模型比流行的事实更能回忆罕见的事实(Calderon等人,2026年;Gekhman等人,2026年).

blocks.en:

Reddit author attribution accuracy (%) by reasoning effort and by how familiar the model says it is with the account. Δ: paired gain from the lowest to the highest effort.
We sort each account by the mean of its own familiarity ratings of the account (0–3 scale); the range of the mean familiarity ratings is in parentheses.
blocks.zh:
表6:当模型对账户略为熟悉,无法弥补其不知道的账户时,理性努力最有帮助。 Reddit作者的归属精度(%)通过推理努力和模型对账户的熟悉度表示. QQ:从最低努力到最高努力的配对收益.
我们按每个账户的熟悉度(0-3分级)来排序;平均熟悉度的幅度在括号内。

blocks.en: The knowledge that lets a model recognize a writer also lets it write like one. We ask Opus 5.5 to generate two Reddit comments in the style of each of 569 accounts, given only the username and subreddit, and pass each comment to Opus 5.5. It names the target from at least one imitation for 74 of 166 accounts (45%) that Opus 5.5 both rates as familiar and identifies from real comments, vs. 9 of 219 (4%) familiar accounts it fails to identify, 5 of 31 (16%) accounts it identifies but does not rate familiar, and 0 of 149 unfamiliar, unidentified accounts. Although this test only measures whether an imitation is attributed to the target by a model rather than a human reader, it suggests that memorized author profiles can be used for impersonation.
blocks.zh: 让模特儿认出作家的知识 也让它像写作一样 我们要求Opus 5.5在569个账户的每个样式中生成两个Reddit评论,只给出用户名和subreddit,并将每个评论传递给Opus 5.5. 它从至少一个模仿166个账户中的74个账户(45%)中将目标命名为Opus 5.5既熟悉,又从实际评论中确认,219个账户中有9个(4%)熟悉,31个账户中有5个(16%)查明但不熟悉,149个陌生、不明身份的账户中有0个。 虽然这一测试只衡量仿真是否被模型而不是人类阅读器归因于目标,但它暗示,被记住的作者简介可以用于冒充.

blocks.en: 5.2 Implications for anonymity
blocks.zh: 5.2 对匿名的影响

blocks.en: Even when a text is brand new, a model can identify its writer from what it learned about them elsewhere; i.e., once that knowledge is in the weights, the writer cannot do anything about it. This leaves people with the largest public footprints, such as active social media users or established authors, permanently exposed, since paraphrasing the text does not completely remove the deanonymization risk. Moreover, the set of vulnerable writers expands as models improve. On Reddit posts, Fable 5.2 names the correct account on 14.3 more percentage points than Opus 5.5 and additional reasoning extends identification to writers a model knows only weakly. Maintaining anonymity is especially important for peer review. Our private lab review data comes from only six writers, but a study across thousands of private peer reviews is underway.
blocks.zh: 即使一个文本是全新的,一个模型也能从它在别处学到的关于他们的知识中识别出它的作家;即一旦知识在权重中,写作者就无法对此做任何事情. 这让公众足迹最大的人,如活跃的社交媒体用户或已成名的作者,永久曝光,因为翻譯文本并不能完全消除去名化的风险. 此外,随着模型的改进,这批弱势作家也在扩大。 在Reddit文章中,Fable 5.2比Opus 5.5多出14.3个百分点的正确帐号,另外的推理将识别延伸至一个模型只知微弱的作者. 保持匿名对同行审议特别重要。 我们的私人实验室审查数据 仅来自六位作者, 但一项研究 覆盖成千上万的私人同行审查。

blocks.en: Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5 refuse most often, on under 2% of all documents (counting provider blocks and written refusals that decline to do the task at all) and mostly on public peer reviews. 26 26 26 Refusals are far rarer through the API than through Claude Code. Claude Fable 5.2 gives no answer on 323 of 1,258 Reddit comments through Claude Code but on only 14 (1.1%, 3 blocked by the provider, 11 written refusals) through OpenRouter batches pinned to Anthropic, which our results use. Models also sometimes make anonymous predictions, which give an explanation and conclude that the author is “anonymous”. The Anthropic provider blocks Fable 5.2 responses on 20 public peer reviews, 3 Reddit comments, and 1 paper, and Opus 5.5 responses on 28 public peer reviews and 2 papers. We additionally identify 151 anonymous predictions from Fable 5.2 and 130 from Opus 5.5, mostly citing insufficient evidence; only 50 of Fable 5.2’s 162 written refusals and anonymous predictions mention privacy or concerns about incorrect attributions. Summing provider blocks, written refusals and anonymous predictions, Fable 5.2 names no author on 6.9% of documents and Opus 5.5 on 6.0%.
blocks.zh: 事实5.2和Opus 5.5最经常的拒绝,在所有文件(计算拒绝完成任务的提供者块和书面拒绝)中,只有不到2%的拒绝,而且大多是公开的同行评审。 26 26 26 通过API的拒绝远远少于通过克劳德代码的拒绝。 Claude Fable 5.2通过Claude Code对1,258 Reddit评论中的323篇没有给出任何答复,但通过OpenRouter批次钉在Anthropic上,我们的结果只使用了14篇(1.1%,3篇被提供者封锁,11篇书面拒绝)。 模型有时还作出匿名的预测,这给出了解释,并得出结论,作者是“匿名的”。 Anthropic提供商封锁了Fable 5.2对20份公开同行评审的回应,3份Reddit评论,1份论文,以及Opus 5.5对28份公开同行评审的回应和2份论文. 此外,我们从Fable 5.2和Opus 5.5找到151个匿名预测,大多引用不充分的证据;在Fable 5.2的162个书面拒绝和匿名预测中,只有50个提到隐私或对错误归属的关切。 Summing提供者块,书面拒绝和匿名预测,Fable 5.2名字没有作者在6.9%的文档上,Opus 5.5在6.0%.

blocks.en: We test paraphrasing as a defense against author identification, using Argon at medium effort to revise texts from § 4 . The prompt asks it to make the author’s style less identifiable while preserving content and meaning, a form of authorship obfuscation ( Brennan et al., 2012 ; Mahmood et al., 2019 ; Fisher et al., 2024 ) . We rewrite each text twice, run author attribution on both rewrites with Opus 5.5 and Argon, and average the two accuracies. Accuracy drops in nearly all domains. On Reddit, Opus 5.5 drops from 16.8% to 10.4% and Argon from 10.0% to 6.9%; on public reviews, the two models drop from 20.8–23.5% to 14.8–15.2%. Private reviews show larger drops, from 40.7–41.2% to 14.9–15.6%. Stories and papers are the least affected by paraphrasing. Argon drops from 18.6% to 15.8% on stories and Opus 5.5 from 34.7% to 31.4% on papers ( Table 39 ). Familiar authors remain easier to identify after paraphrasing. Of the 34 stories whose authors Opus 5.5 rates very familiar (2.5–3 on the 0–3 scale), it names 32 authors before rewriting and 27.5 after, on average over the two rewrites ( Figure 7 ).
blocks.zh: 我们用Argon作为反驳作者身份的辩护理由,在中等程度上努力修改第4款的案文。 即时电请它让作者的风格在保留内容和意义的同时更难识别,这是一种作者化的模糊形式(Brennan等人,2012年;Mahmood等人,2019年;Fisher等人,2024年). 我们重写每个文本两次, 运行作者归属 在两个重写 Opus 5.5 和 Argon, 平均两个加速。 精确度在几乎所有域都下降。 在Reddit上,Opus 5.5从16.8%下降到10.4%,Argon从10.0%下降到6.9%;在公共评论上,两种模式从20.8–23.5%下降到14.8–15.2%。 私人评论显示下降幅度较大,从40.7-41.2 %下降到14.9-15.6%。 故事和论文受到抛写的影响最小。 Argon的故事从18.6%下降到15.8%,Opus 5.5的故事从34.7%下降到31.4%(表39)。 较熟悉的作者在解说后仍然更容易识别。 在作者Opus 5.5率非常熟悉的34篇报道(2.5–3分0–3分)中,在重写前列出32篇作者,在重写后列出27.5篇作者,平均在两篇重写后列出(图7).

blocks.en: 6 Related work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Traditional AI-text detectors rely on statistical approaches ( Gehrmann et al., 2019 ; Mitchell et al., 2023 ; Bao et al., 2024 ; Hans et al., 2024 ) or fine-tuned classifiers ( Hu et al., 2023 ; Glickenhaus et al., 2026 ; Adam et al., 2026 ) . Earlier prompt-based detection concluded prompting was unreliable at flagging AI-generated text ( Bhattacharjee & Liu, 2024 ; Russell et al., 2025 ) . Bao et al. (2025) and Rajendhran et al. (2026) detect AI-generated prose and AI-generated ideas separately. Uchendu et al. (2020) introduce the task of classifying which model generated a text, given the options of several generators. Uchendu et al. (2021) and Sun et al. (2025) find that classifiers trained on a fixed set of generators can tell them apart. In zero-shot settings, LLMs can pick up on AI-generated stylistic cues ( Barkhordar & Thapa, 2026 ; Davidson et al., 2024 ) but identification fails once those cues are controlled. Panickssery et al. (2024) find models identify and favor their own generations.
blocks.zh: 传统的AI文本检测器依赖于统计方法(Gehrmann等人,2019年;Mitchell等人,2023年;Bao等人,2024年;Hans等人,2024年)或微调分类器. (Hu等人,2023年;Glickenhaus等人,2026年;Adam等人,2026年). 早期的即时检测结论在标出AI生成的文本时是不可靠的(Bhattacharjee & Liu, 2024年;Russell等人, 2025年)。 Bao等人(2025年)和Rajendhran等人著. (2026)分别检测AI生成的散文和AI生成的想法. Uchendu等人(2020年)介绍了鉴于若干发电机的选择,对哪些模型生成文本进行分类的任务。 Uchendu等人(2021年)和Sun等人(2025年)发现,在固定发电机组上受训的分类人员可以将其区分开来. 在零镜头设置中,LLMs可以在AI生成的语义提示(Barkhordar & Thapa, 2026; Davidson等人, 2024)上接取,但一旦这些提示被控制,识别失败. Panickssery等人(2024年)发现模型识别并喜欢自己的几代人.

blocks.en:
Early approaches used stylometry or embeddings to identify authorship ( Mosteller & Wallace, 1964 ; Narayanan et al., 2012 ; Rivera-Soto et al., 2021 ; Stamatatos, 2009 ; Koppel et al., 2011 ; Wegmann et al., 2022 ). For peer review, Hill & Provost (2003) identify authors 40–45% of the time from their citations alone, and Bauersfeld et al. (2023) ; Caragea et al. (2019) identify the authors of 73% of papers from their text and references.
Many prior studies point to the threat of deanonymization, but use limited candidate pools, retrieval setups, or agentic tooling to extract information about an author ( Lermen et al., 2026 ; Zhang & Zhang, 2026 ; Gloire & Mitra, 2026 ; Staab et al., 2024 ; Tan et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2024 ). Adewumi et al. (2025) and Hicke & Mimno (2025) find LLMs can identify famous authors from text alone but struggle with less popular writers, and in open-world quote attribution, accuracy likewise rises with the speaker’s fame ( Berman et al., 2026 ) . LLMs’ familiarity with a text relates to how often that specific text appears in pretraining data ( Chang et al., 2023 ; Kandpal et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
早期的方法使用型式或嵌入法来识别作者身份(Mosteller & Wallace,1964年;Narayanan等人,2012年;Rivera-Soto等人,2021年;Stamatatos,2009年;Koppel等人,2011年;Wegmann等人,2022年)。 对于同行评审,Hill & Provost (2003年) 单独从引用中找出作者40–45%的时间,Bauersfeld等人(2023年);Caragea等人(2019年)从文本和参考文献中找出73%论文的作者.
许多先前的研究都指出了去名化的威胁,但使用有限的候选集合,检索设置,或代理工具来提取作者的信息(Lermen等人,2026年;张和章,2026年;Gloire & Mitra,2026年;Staab等人,2024年;Tan等人,2025年;Huang等人,2024年)。 Adewumi等人(2025年)和Hicke & Mimno (2025年)发现LLMS能够单独从文本中识别出著名的作者,但与不太受欢迎的作家们进行斗争,在开放世界引用归属中,准确性也随着演讲者的名声而上升(Berman等人,2026年). LLMs对案文的熟悉程度涉及该具体案文在培训前数据中的出现频率(Chan等人,2023年;Kandpal等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We demonstrate that closed-source frontier models can match trained AI-text detectors, name the specific model behind AI-generated texts, and perform human authorship attribution given only a single text and a zero-shot prompt. Attribution is easier when the model is familiar with the human author; we can predict which authors a model can unmask by asking it how familiar it is with a given name. Models are also rapidly improving at this task. Claude Fable 5.2 (released on November 9, 2026) is the strongest model we tested at naming both labs and people. Defenses are limited, since models rarely refuse, writing cannot be deleted from existing weights, and AI rewriting only partly helps. Anyone who has published enough writing online can no longer assume that an unsigned text keeps them anonymous.
blocks.zh: 我们证明,闭源边疆模型可以匹配训练有素的AI文本检测器,命名AI生成文本背后的具体模型,并且执行人类作者的归属,只给出一个文本和一个零镜头的提示. 当模型熟悉人类作者时,归属就更容易了;我们可以通过询问该模型对特定名称的熟悉程度来预测哪个作者可以解析模型. 在这项工作中,模型也正在迅速改进。 Claude Fable 5.2(2026年11月9日发布)是我们在命名实验室和人时测试的最强模型. 辩护是有限的,因为模型很少拒绝,写作不能从现有的权重中删除,而AI重写只是部分帮助. 任何在网上发表足够著作的人,都不能再假设没有签名的文字会让他们匿名.

blocks.en: Ethical considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: The people most affected by this work are those who rely on anonymity. Reviewers in double-blind review could face retaliation from authors whose papers they rejected, and pseudonymous forum users could be harassed or doxxed once their accounts are linked to them. This is especially dangerous for those whose safety depends on staying anonymous, such as whistleblowers, activists, and survivors of abuse. Models are also able to imitate users they recognize (§ 5 ), so the same knowledge could be used to impersonate them. We recognize that publishing this work may lead some readers to try these attacks themselves; however, we believe it is more important to raise awareness of these capabilities to spur future research on defenses, especially given how simple and accessible they are.
blocks.zh: 受这项工作影响最大的是那些依赖匿名的人. 双盲审查中的审查者可能面临其论文被他们拒绝的作者的报复,假名论坛用户一旦其账户与他们联系起来,就可能遭到骚扰或涂鸦。 这对那些安全依赖于匿名的人,如告密者、活动家和虐待幸存者,尤其危险。 模型还能够模仿他们认识的用户(§5),因此同样的知识可以用来冒充他们. 我们认识到,出版这部作品可能会让一些读者自己尝试这些攻击;然而,我们认为,更重要的是要提高对这些能力的认识,以刺激今后对防御的研究,特别是考虑到这些能力是多么简单和容易获取.

blocks.en: Existing capability. All of our results come from simply prompting publicly available models. Each model names the author of a single text in a zero-shot setting, without tools, web access, a candidate list, or writing samples, nor do we train any models. This requires no programming or data collection, as anyone is able to paste a text and our prompt into a chat interface. Models also rarely refuse this task. Even Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5, the models that refused most often, did so on fewer than 2% of documents through the API. The risk is therefore already present in widely accessible models, and exists regardless of whether this paper was published.
blocks.zh: 现有能力。 我们的所有结果都来自简单的鼓励公开模式。 每个模型在零镜头设定中命名单一文本的作者,没有工具,网络访问,候选名单,或者写样本,我们也不训练任何模型. 这不需要编程或数据收集,因为任何人都可以粘贴一个文本,我们也可以迅速进入聊天界面. 模型也很少拒绝这项任务. 甚至Fable 5.2和Opus 5.5这些最经常拒绝的型号,通过API在不到2%的文件中都这样做了. 因此,这种风险已经存在于可广泛获取的模型中,无论该文件是否发表,都存在。

blocks.en: The risk will grow without intervention. We expect this risk to increase as models improve. Claude Fable 5.2 identifies the author of nearly twice as many Reddit comments as Opus 5.5, which was only released two months earlier. Furthermore, a higher reasoning effort also allows models to identify authors they are barely familiar with. Nothing a writer does now can remove what a model has already learned about them from its weights. Delaying this work would not make these writers any safer, and would only keep them from knowing they are at risk.
blocks.zh: 没有干预,风险就会增加。 我们期望随着模型的改进,这种风险会增加。 Claude Fable 5.2将Reddit评论的作者确定为Opus 5.5的近两倍,该评论在两个月前才发布. 此外,更高的推理能力也使模型能够识别他们不太熟悉的作者。 编剧现在所做的一切 都无法从模型的重量中去除 已经学到的东西。 拖延这项工作不会使这些作家更加安全,只会使他们不知悉他们的处境。

blocks.en: Benefits of publication. We believe the benefits of publishing this work outweigh the risks, since most people who write anonymously are likely unaware that a model can identify them from a single text. Model developers are also able to reduce this risk, for example by having models refuse these requests more often (we informed Anthropic and OpenAI about our findings prior to publication). This is already possible, with Fable 5.2 refusing 323 of 1,258 Reddit comments through Claude Code compared to only 14 through the API. Our results also show that paraphrasing a text is only a partial defense, and better defenses against both identification and impersonation still need to be developed.
blocks.zh: 出版的好处。 我们认为出版这部作品的好处大于风险,因为大多数匿名写作的人很可能不知道一个模型可以从一个文本中识别出来. 模型开发者也能够减少这种风险,例如让模型更经常地拒绝这些请求(我们在发布前将我们的调查结果通知了Anthropic和OpenAI)。 这已经是可能的,Fable 5.2通过Claude Code拒绝了1,258个Reddit评论中的323个,而通过API只有14个. 我们的结果还表明,对文本的诠释只是部分的辩护,对识别和冒充的更好的辩护还需要加以发展.

blocks.en: Data protection. All scoring was done locally. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash was restricted to OpenRouter hosts with zero data retention. All other models were accessed through paid APIs (via OpenRouter or Google’s Gemini API) whose terms exclude API inputs and outputs from model training. The private reviews were contributed voluntarily by their own authors. All other data is publicly available, and we report results on it in aggregate. The only people we mention by name are already well-known authors or researchers and their associated texts are publicly signed (not anonymous); we name them only as illustrative examples. We do not release any author predictions or private data.
blocks.zh: 数据保护. 所有评分都在当地完成. 深层搜索 V4.1 Flash被限制在OpenRouter主机上,数据保留为零. 所有其他模型都通过付费API(通过OpenRouter或Google的双子公司API)访问,其条款将API投入和产出排除在模型培训之外. 私人评论是由自己的作者自愿提供的。 所有其他数据均可公开查阅,我们报告汇总结果。 我们只提到姓名的作者或研究人员,他们的相关文本是公开签名的(不是匿名的);我们仅将它们命名为示例。 我们不发布任何作者的预测或私人数据。

blocks.en: B.3.2 Explanation agreement
blocks.zh: B.3.2 解释协议

blocks.en:
An LLM judge (Claude Opus 5.5) aligns two explanations of the same document, E A E_{A} and E B E_{B} , separately for prose and ideas. Each explanation lists evidence items (a statement, quotes, a lean and its strength, and a justification), names a decisive factor and gives an AI share s ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] s\in[0,1] ( Figure 12 ).
In a first call, which hides leans, justifications, and verdicts, the judge groups items from the two explanations that make the same point, even when they quote different passages; every group holds at least one item from each explanation, and items that fit into no group stay unmatched. It also maps each point in the decisive factors to a matched group or an unmatched item.
In a second call, the judge is provided each group’s leans and justifications and decides whether both explanations rest on the same property of evidence in the group.
blocks.zh:
一名LLM法官(Claude Opus 5.5)将同一文件的两个解释,即E A E_{A}和E B E_{B},分别用于散文和构思. 每一份解释都列出了证据项目(一份陈述、一份引文、一份精益及其强度以及一份理由)、一份决定性因素,并给出一份AI 股[0、1] s\ in [0、1] (图12)。
法官们在第一次呼吁中隐藏了倾斜、理由和判决,在两次解释中将提出同样观点的内容分组起来,即使他们引用了不同的段落;每个解释中,每个解释中至少有一个内容,任何与任何一组相适应的内容都保持不变。 它还将决定性因素中的每个点映射到匹配的组或未匹配的项目.
在第二次传唤中,向法官提供每个团体的优势和理由,并决定两个解释是否都取决于该团体中同一证据财产。

blocks.en: Let 𝒢 \mathcal{G} be the set of groups, U A U_{A} and U B U_{B} the set of unmatched items each from documents A A and B B , and D A D_{A} and D B D_{B} the set of decisive factors mapped to a group or an unmatched item. • Verdict is 1 if both AI shares fall on the same side of 0.5. • Evidence F1 = 2 ​ | 𝒢 | / ( 2 ​ | 𝒢 | + | U A | + | U B | ) =2|\mathcal{G}|/(2|\mathcal{G}|+|U_{A}|+|U_{B}|) , the harmonic mean of the share of each explanation’s points that the other also makes (each group counts as one shared point). • Interpretation is the share of groups whose items all have the same lean and the judge determines the justification of those items to be identical. • Decisive F1 = 2 ​ | D A ∩ D B | / ( | D A | + | D B | ) =2|D_{A}\cap D_{B}|/(|D_{A}|+|D_{B}|) , and 0 when exactly one set is empty. Undefined values (both sets empty, or no groups for interpretation) are dropped for that metric only. blocks.en: B.3.3 Cues cited in explanations

blocks.en:
We analyze Opus 5.5 and Sol explanations of 2,432 documents from 24 datasets, with separate prose and idea judgments from each detector (9,728 judgments in total). Sol at high effort discovers features from their evidence and reasons, and merges them across datasets and detectors into catalogs of 132 idea and 119 prose features; each itemized evidence is then assigned one feature or none.
Through these catalogs of features, we find that the cues frequently cited by LLM detectors align with findings from prior work. Table 18 presents two matches with our feature catalog per study that share both the characteristic and the attribution direction; our features describe cues cited by frontier models rather than their reliability as gold provenance markers.

我们从24个数据集分析2,432份文件的Opus 5.5和Sol解释,从每个探测器(总共9,728项判断)中分别分析传言和思想判断。 高强度地解决了从证据和理由中发现特征的问题,并把它们跨数据集和探测器合并成132个想法和119个流派特征的目录;然后将每个逐项证据指定一个特征或一个特征。
通过这些特征目录,我们发现LLM探测器经常引用的提示与以前工作的结果一致. 表18列出了与我们每项研究的特征目录的两种匹配,它们都具有特征和归属方向;我们的特征描述的是前沿模型引用的提示,而不是它们作为黄金来源标记的可靠性。

blocks.en: Accuracy on the big three labs also reflects how often detectors name them. Figure 13 shows, for each detector, which lab it names for each writing lab’s texts, and Table 23 gives the precision of its answers per named lab and its macro-F1 over the 11 writing labs. Opus 5.5 and Argon name Anthropic and OpenAI even more often. Sol and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash name Anthropic or OpenAI for nearly every text, and DeepSeek never names Google, so their macro-F1 is 11 and 4. We hypothesize some of this over-predicting may be effects of distillation.

blocks.en: C.3.1 Model writing profiles
blocks.zh: C.3.1 示范写作简介

blocks.en: Detectors will often describe the same writing traits in different words. So to count how often the detectors cite each trait, we adapt the methods of Brassington et al. (2026) and Pham et al. (2024) to assemble our model profiles: 1. We split each explanation into its key observations, each of which points to a lab, e.g. “numerical claims come with hedges about scope and method” (GPT). Opus 5.5, Argon, Sol and DeepSeek in total generated 288,430 observations. 2. Opus 5.5 groups each detector’s observations about each lab into cues, then merges them into three lists for observations on the text overall (489 cues), its ideas (492 cues), and its prose (337 cues), so “numerical claims come with hedges about scope and method” and “repeatedly hedges against overclaiming” are counted as the same trait. 3. Opus 5.5 labels every observation with these lists, without seeing the detector or the lab. Since Fable 5.2 was released after feature discovery for the writing traits, we only run this labelling step on its observations. We define a lab’s traits as cues at least twice as frequent in observations pointing to that lab as in those pointing to other labs (e.g. dry wit for Claude), and say a writer shares a trait if its rate on the writer’s texts is at least the midpoint between the lab’s rate and the highest other big lab’s.
blocks.zh: 探测器会经常用不同的词描述相同的写作特征. 因此,为了计算探测器引用每个特征的频率,我们调整了Brassington等人(2026年)和Pham等人(2024年)的方法,以组装我们的模型简介: 1. 我们把每项解释分为关键观察,其中每一项都指向实验室,例如 " 数字索赔涉及范围和方法的套期保值 " (GPT)。 Opus 5.5,Argon,Sol和DeepSeek共生成288,430个观测数据. 2. Opus 5.5 将每个探测器对每个实验室的观测结果组合成提示,然后将它们合并为三个清单,以便对整个文本(489个提示)、其想法(492个提示)和它的道具(337个提示)进行观测,因此,“数字索赔涉及范围和方法的套期”和“重复的对冲,反对过度主张”被算作相同的特征。 3. Opus 5.5用这些清单标注每个观测结果,没有看到探测器或实验室。 由于Fable 5.2在发现写作特征后发布,我们只在它的观察上运行这个标记步骤. 我们把实验室的特性定义为至少比其他实验室(如克劳德的干智)更频繁地观测到实验室的特征, 并说如果作者的文本率至少是实验室比率与其它大实验室比率的中点, 作者的特征是相同的。
