blocks.en: C.3.2 Misattributions and reported distillation
blocks.zh: C.3.2 滥用和报告的蒸馏

blocks.en: This section expands on the distillation results in § 3.1 .
blocks.zh: 本节扩展了蒸馏结果第3.1节.

blocks.en: Figure 14 : Claude Fable 5.2 recognizes most texts from earlier Kimi and Qwen releases, but attributes nearly every Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3 text to Claude and most Qwen3.8 27B and Grok 4.7 texts to GPT. Each column is one writer, oldest to newest within each lab.
blocks.zh: 图14 Claude Fable 5.2识别出大部分来自早先的Kimi和Quen发行的文本,但将几乎每个Kimi K3和GLM-5.3文本都归属于Claude和大多数Quen3.8 27B和Grok 4.7文本归属于GPT. 每个栏目都是一位作家,每个实验室内最古老到最新的.

blocks.en: If a detector is able to recognize a lab’s earlier models, we would expect it to also recognize its newer ones, unless their style has changed. Fable 5.2 names the right lab for most texts from Kimi K2.5 and K2.6 and from the three Qwen releases preceding Qwen3.8, where Opus 5.5 and Argon often answer Claude or GPT instead ( Table 20 ). But even Fable 5.2 attributes nearly every Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3 text to Claude, and most Qwen3.8 27B and Grok 4.7 texts to GPT ( Figure 14 ). Because Fable 5.2 knows these labs’ earlier models, its errors suggest that their newest releases no longer read like those models, but like Claude or GPT. Fable 5.2 recognizes few texts from any GLM or MiniMax release, so we cannot make the same comparison for these two labs.
blocks.zh: 如果一个探测器能够识别实验室早期的模型,我们期望它也能识别其较新的模型,除非它们的风格已经改变。 寓言5.2将来自Kimi K2.5和K2.6的大多数文本以及Quen3.8之前的3个Quen的文本命名为右实验室,其中Opus 5.5和Argon经常回答克劳德或GPT(表20). 但即使是Fable 5.2,几乎每个Kimi K3和GLM-5.3的文本都归于克劳德,大多数Quen3.8 27B和Grok 4.7的文本都归于GBT(图14). 因为Fable 5.2知道这些实验室早期的模型,它的误差表明它们最新的释放不再像这些模型一样读取,而是像克劳德或GPT一样读取. 寓言5.2 很少识别出任何GLM或MiniMax释放的文本,因此我们不能对这两个实验室作同样的比较.

blocks.en: The first reports named labs but not models, and did not say when the campaigns ran. Later reports do both. A joint advisory by US agencies reports that Moonshot trained Kimi K3 on Claude Fable 5 data ( National Security Agency et al., 2026 ) , and Anthropic reports a Moonshot campaign against Claude between May and July 2026 ( Anthropic, 2026d ) . K3 came out in July. Anthropic also reports a 17-day Zhipu campaign against Claude Opus 4.8 in June and July, and that Zhipu distilled the cyber capabilities of multiple frontier models during the development of GLM-5.3, which came out in August ( Anthropic, 2026d ; Anthropic, 2026a ) . These are the two releases that all three detectors attribute almost entirely to Claude.
blocks.zh: 最初的报告给实验室起名,但没有给模型取名,也没有说运动何时展开。 后来的报告都是这样。 美国机构的联合咨询报告说,月球射击在克劳德·福尔5数据(国家安全局等,2026年)上训练了Kimi K3,而Anthropic则报告说,2026年5月至7月(Anthropic,2026年d月)对克劳德进行了月球射击运动. K3于7月出道. Anthropic还报道了6月和7月针对克劳德·奥普斯·4.8的为期17天的日普战役,日普在开发GLM-5.3时对多个前沿模型的网络能力进行了提炼,8月推出(Anthropic,2026d;Anthropic,2026a). 这些是三个探测器几乎全部归于克劳德的两个释放物.

blocks.en: Reports link Alibaba and MiniMax to both Claude and GPT. Anthropic reported more exchanges from Alibaba than from any other lab, used to distill Claude into Qwen3.5 through 3.7 ( Anthropic, 2026d ) , and the advisory reports that both labs distilled Claude models and GPT-5 ( National Security Agency et al., 2026 ) . Fable 5.2 names Alibaba for 80% or more of the texts from each of the three earlier Qwen releases, but all three detectors attribute most Qwen3.8 27B and Qwen3.8 Max texts to GPT. Anthropic reported distillation of Claude by MiniMax in February ( Anthropic, 2026b ) , the month MiniMax M2.5 came out, and the detectors attribute M2.5 mostly to Claude. The additional link to GPT-5 came in the September advisory, and the detectors attribute nearly every text by the newer M3 and M3.1 Flash to GPT.
blocks.zh: 报告将Alibaba和MiniMax与克劳德和GPT联系起来。 Anthropic报告来自阿里巴巴的交流比来自任何其他实验室的交流更多,用于将克劳德蒸馏成Quen3.5至3.7(Anthropic, 2026d),以及两个实验室都蒸馏克劳德模型和GPT-5(国家安全局等, 2026)的咨询报告. 寓言5.2将阿里巴巴命名为八成或以上来自早期三个Quen发布版本的文本,但所有三个探测器都将大多数Qune3.8 27B和Qune3.8 Max文本归为GBT. Anthropic在2月报道了MiniMax对Claude的蒸馏(Anthropic,2026b),月度MiniMax M2.5出现,探测器将M2.5大多归于Claude. 与GPT-5的附加链接出现在9月的咨询中,探测器将较新的M3和M3.1 Flash的几乎每个文本都归于GPT.

blocks.en: C.3.3 Exploring alternative explanations for the misattributions.
blocks.zh: 第3.3条 探索对误报的替代解释.

blocks.en: The misattributions in Figure 14 are consistent with reported distillation, but there are other explanations that could produce them. Opus 5.5 and Argon often answer Claude or GPT for the earlier Kimi and Qwen releases that Fable 5.2 is able to properly attribute, so detectors may be falling back to known labs when they don’t recognize the model who wrote the text, for instance because it came out after the detectors’ training cutoff. Another possibility is the newest open models may resemble Claude or GPT only because Clark et al. (2026) found that recent models from several labs share an information-dense writing style. We investigate both using stylometric analysis by checking whether the detectors’ answers match stylometry, and then controlling for information density features from Clark et al. (2026) to see if the newest releases are still closest to Claude or GPT.
blocks.zh: 图14中的误差与所报告的蒸馏一致,但还有其他可以产生这些误差的解释. Opus 5.5和Argon经常为早先的Kimi和Qwen的释放回答Claude或GPT,Fable 5.2能够正确属性,因此探测器在不识别编写文本的模型时可能会掉回已知的实验室,例如因为它是在探测器的训练截断后出来的. 另一个可能性是最新的开放模型可能与克劳德或GPT相似,只是因为Clark等人(2026年)发现,来自多个实验室的近期模型都具有信息密集的写作风格. 我们通过检查探测器的答案是否与定型仪相符来调查时态分析,然后控制克拉克等人(2026年)的信息密度特征,看看最新的释放是否仍然最接近克劳德或GPT.

blocks.en: Figure 15 : The closer stylometry places a writer to Claude or to GPT, the more often the detectors attribute its texts to that lab. Each point is one writer outside of the Claude, GPT, and Gemini model families (newest releases in bold), with detectors and domains pooled. Burrows’ Delta is measured to each lab’s closest model.
blocks.zh: 图15: 造型方法越接近Claude或GPT的写手,探测器就越经常将其文本归于该实验室. 每个点都是克劳德、GPT和双子座模范家庭以外的一位作家(以粗体表示的最新发行),其探测器和域都聚集在一起。 Burrows的三角洲被测量到每个实验室最近的模型。

blocks.en:
We compare writers with Burrows’ Delta ( Burrows, 2002 ) over the relative frequencies of the 150 most common words and 16 punctuation, sentence and formatting features. 27 27 27 Em dashes, en dashes, semicolons, colons, parentheses, question marks, exclamation marks, ellipses, quotation marks, “not X but Y”, words per sentence, spread of sentence length, one-sentence paragraphs, words per paragraph, markdown lines and word length. Within each domain of § C.1 , we z-score each feature over all texts, and the distance between two writers is the mean absolute difference of their average z-scores over the prompts both wrote (0 means identical). For each pair of consecutive releases from a lab outside of the big three, we take the change in distance to each Claude, GPT, and Gemini model and test it with a paired bootstrap over prompts (2,000 resamples) and Holm correction across those models.
We estimate the distance between the writer and itself as about 0.2 by splitting each writer’s texts into two random halves and measuring the distance between them. Stylometry is able to separate the big three, with each Claude, GPT and Gemini model nearest another model from its own lab in every domain. This is consistent with Sun et al. (2025) , who find that classifiers are able to tell apart the outputs of different LLM families, and Shan et al. (2026) , who find that AI writers have a consistent stylometric footprint.
blocks.zh:
我们在150个最常用的单词和16个标点、句子和格式化特征的相对频率上与Burrows的Delta(Burrows,2002年)的作者进行比较。 27 27 Em dashes, en dustes, 分号, 结号, 括号, 问题标记, 感叹标记, 椭圆形, 引号, “不是X而是Y ” , 每句单词, 句长的分布, 单句式段落, 段落的单句, 标记线和字长。 在§C.1的每个域内,我们每个z-分数在所有文本中都有每个特征,两个作者之间的距离是他们的平均z-分数相对于所写的提示(0表示相同)的平均绝对差. 每对连续从大三号外的实验室释放出来, 我们把改变的距离 到每个克劳德,GPT,和双子座模型, 用双靴子测试它 超过提示(2,000个复标)和Holm校正这些模型。
我们估计作者与自己之间的距离约为0.2, 造型学能够将大三相分离,每个Claude,GPT和双子座模型都离自己在每一个领域的实验室最近的是另一个模型. 这与Sun等人(2025年)和Shan等人(2026年)一致,后者认为分类者能够分辨不同LLM家族的输出,而Shan等人(2026年)则发现AI作家有着一致的定型脚印.

blocks.en: We first look at whether the detectors’ answers follow each writer’s style, or whether they fall back to a known lab regardless of how the text is written. We compare the percent of each writer’s texts the detectors attribute to Claude with how much closer stylometry places it to Claude than to GPT ( Figure 15 ), and find that the two are strongly correlated (Spearman ρ = 0.85 \rho=0.85 ), with about the same correlation for each detector on its own. The stylometry, like our detectors, split the newest Kimi, GLM, Qwen, and MiniMax releases between Claude and GPT (all but Qwen3.8 27B are within 0.21–0.24 of their nearest model, against at least 0.27 for these labs’ earlier releases). Within the MiniMax family, stylometry places M2.5 nearest Claude Sonnet 4.6 and M3 nearest GPT-5.6 Sol on news and op-eds, and the detectors go from mostly answering Claude for M2.5 to nearly always answering GPT for M3.
blocks.zh: 我们首先研究探测器的答案是否跟随每个作家的风格, 我们比较了每个编剧文本中由探测器归结到克劳德的百分率,以及它和GPT相比在造型上离克劳德有多近(图15),并发现两者密切相关(Spearman $ = 0.85\rho= 0.85),而每个探测器本身的关联性大致相同。 与我们的探测器一样,该型号将最新的基米、GLM、Quen和MiniMax的释放在克劳德和GPT之间分割开来(除Qune3.8 27B外,其余均在它们最近的型号0.21-0.24以内,而这些实验室早先的释放至少为0.27)。 在Minimax家族中,造型法将距离最近的M2.5 Claude Sonnet 4.6和距离最近的M3 GPT-5.6 Sol放在新闻和专栏上,探测器从主要回答Claude的M2.5到几乎总是回答GPT的M3.

blocks.en:
Clark et al. (2026) find that recent models from several labs write in a dense style that saves tokens, but also makes it harder for people to read. To test whether the misattributions can be explained by a convergence in AI writing style, we re-implement six of their measures: object relative clauses with and without a relativizer, stacked nouns (compounds of three or more nouns), dependency length, unattested bigrams, and trigram perplexity. 28 28 28 We parse with spaCy
( en_core_web_trf , and build the reference sample from 500,000 words of English Wikipedia. We then regress each stylometric feature on these six measures over all texts in a domain, and recompute the distances on the residuals. The six measures predict little of most features, with an average R 2 R^{2} of 0.06--0.08, and predict word length and sentence length best. On the residuals, Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3 are still nearest a Claude model and the newest Qwen and MiniMax releases nearest a GPT model in every domain, with 7 of the 12 shifts toward Claude and 16 of the 18 toward GPT still significant. 29 29 29 The shifts toward Claude keep a median of 60% of their size (Kimi K3 48%, GLM-5.3 71%), and the shifts toward GPT keep 101% (Qwen 105%, MiniMax 101%).
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: Appendix D Which human wrote the text?
blocks.zh: 附录D 是哪个人类写的?

blocks.en: In this section, we discuss data, additional results, and analysis related to human author attribution (§ 4 ).
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们讨论有关人类作者归属的数据、额外结果和分析(第4节)。

blocks.en: D.1 Data preparation
blocks.zh: D.1 数据编制

blocks.en: Before sending each text to the model for attribution, we remove all direct identity clues (i.e. paper bylines), while keeping some indirect clues like self-citations.
blocks.zh: 在将每个文本发送给模型进行归属之前,我们删除所有直接的身份线索(即纸面旁线),同时保留一些间接的线索,如自我引用.

blocks.en:
Papers. We extract the main text from arXiv’s HTML. We remove the byline (author names, affiliations and emails), the bibliography, the appendices and any section about acknowledgements, funding, author contributions, competing interests or disclosures.
We replace emails, URLs (including GitHub and Hugging Face links) and arXiv identifiers with placeholders, as well as any affiliation from the byline that appears verbatim. We keep in-body citations. For each paper, we count self-citations and split accuracy by these counts ( Table 4 ). Since the full main text is the condition most exposed to leakage, the topic-only baselines in § D.4.2 give the model only keywords or the title and abstract.
blocks.zh:
证件。 我们从arXiv的HTML中提取正文. 我们删除了标题(作者姓名、隶属关系和电子邮件)、书目、附录和任何关于确认、供资、作者捐款、相互竞争的利益或披露的章节。
我们用占位符替换电子邮件、URL(包括GitHub和Hugging Face链接)和arXiv标识符,以及从副线显示的逐字记录中的任何关联。 我们保持内在引用。 对于每份文件,我们按这些数字计算自引词和分数准确性(表4)。 由于正文全文是最暴露于渗漏的条件,所以§D.4.2中仅标的基线只给出模型关键词或标题和抽象.

blocks.en: D.4.2 Topic-only baseline experiments
blocks.zh: D.4.2 仅进行专题基线试验

blocks.en: It is possible that a model could name an author because it knows who works on a given topic, not because it recognizes how they write (i.e. use content of the text instead of stylistic features). To check this, we give the model only the topic of a text (keywords, or a title and abstract) and ask who works on it or reviewed it. We then compare that with attribution from the full text. We find that providing the full text gives higher accuracy on both papers and public reviews ( Table 35 and Table 36 ).
blocks.zh: 一个模型可能可以给作者取名,因为它知道谁在某一特定主题上工作,而不是因为它承认他们如何写作(即使用文本的内容而不是风格特征). 为了检查这一点,我们只给模型一个文本的主题(关键词,或标题和抽象),并询问谁在做它的工作或审查它. 然后,我们将这一点与全文中的归属相比较。 我们认为,提供全文使论文和公开评论更加准确(表35和表36)。

The topic-only prompts ask for one early-career and one senior researcher who work on the problem; the full-text prompt asks for the most likely junior and senior author. A name counts if the person is any author of the paper, whatever role Opus 5.5 gives them.

blocks.en: D.4.3 Stability across repeated judgments and paraphrasing
blocks.zh: D.4.3 反复判决和解释的稳定性

blocks.en: In five independent Fable 5.2 judgments of Reddit comments, overall accuracy ranges from 29.9–31.1% ( Table 37 , top). Only 32.6% of comments receive the same normalized answer in all five runs, whereas 25.0% are correctly attributed in every run and 63.2% are incorrect in every run. The remaining 11.8% are correct in one to four runs. Earlier same-text repeats on a 200-document, five-domain sample also show relatively small accuracy ranges for Argon and Opus 5.5 ( Table 37 , bottom).
blocks.zh: 在5个独立的Fable 5.2判断Reddit评论中,总体准确度在29.9-31.1 %(表37,最高)之间. 只有32.6%的评论在所有五个运行中都得到相同的常态解答,而25.0%的评语在每一个运行中正确归属,63.2%的评语在每一个运行中不正确. 其余的11.8%在1至4次运行中是正确的. 早先的同文在200文档中重复,五域样本也显示Argon和Opus 5.5的准确度范围相对较小(表37,底部).

blocks.en: Following a similar explanation agreement method from § 2 across three judgments on a 200-text sample, we find that Argon has agreement evidence F1 of 0.94 and decisive-factor F1 of 0.79, while Opus has 0.93 and 0.72 F1 respectively. We also find high cross-model Argon/Opus agreement: on a separate 1,000-document sample their evidence F1 is 0.85 and decisive-factor F1 is 0.67 ( Table 38 ).
blocks.zh: 采用类似解释协议方法从§2对200文本样本的三个判决中得出,我们发现Argon有协议证据F1为0.94,决定性因素F1为0.79,而Opus则分别有0.93和0.72 F1. 我们还发现高跨模型的Argon/Opus协议:在单独的1000文件样本上,他们的证据F1是0.85,决定性因素F1是0.67(表38)。
